Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instand and/or sorcery spells.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Cormela and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Put one of the Cormela tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Cormela that died in step 3 and the Cormela that died in step 4 each trigger, returning Cabal Ritual and Saw in Half from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
If you have seven or more cards in your graveyard, this combo nets infinite mana.

Cast Windfall by paying {2}{U}, causing each player to discard their hand and then draw a number of cards equal to the greatest number of cards a player discarded this way.
Razorkin Needlehead triggers for each card drawn this way, giving each opponent a poison counter for each card they drew.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters

combos.description:
Activate Mairsil using Gilded Lotus' ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mairsil using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Activate Mairsil using Quicksilver Elemental's ability by paying {U}, causing it to gain all activated abilities of itself until end of turn.
Repeat.
If desired, you may use any of Staff of Domination's other abilities using Mairsil, and then use Quicksilver Elemental's ability to use them infinitely.

At the beginning of combat, Mishra triggers, creating a 4/4 artifact creature token copy of Gonti's Aether Heart named Mishra's Warform.
When Mishra's Warform enters the battlefield, it and Gonti's Aether Heart trigger twice each, causing you to get eight {E}.
Activate Mishra's Warform by paying eight {E} and exiling it, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

Activate Mairsil using Gilded Lotus' ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mairsil using Morphling's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Mairsil.
Activate Mairsil using Quicksilver Elemental's ability by paying {U}, causing Mairsil to gain all activated abilities of itself until end of turn.
Repeat.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ruthless Ripper, adding {C}{C}.
When Ruthless Ripper dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Ruthless Ripper from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Activate Ruthless Ripper's morph ability by revealing a black card from your hand, turning it face up.
Ruthless Ripper triggers, causing target player to lose 2 life.
Repeat.

Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Ruthless Ripper.
When Ruthless Ripper dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Ruthless Ripper from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Ruthless Ripper's morph ability by revealing a black card from your hand, turning it face up.
Ruthless Ripper triggers, causing target player to lose 2 life.
Repeat.

Put all the Be'lakor tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Each Be'lakor token's first ability triggers, the nontoken Be'lakor's second ability triggers five times, and each Be'lakor token's second ability triggers four times.
Resolve the nontoken Be'lakor triggers, dealing 30 damage to up to 5 targets.
Resolve all the Be'lakor tokens' second abilities, dealing 120 damage to up to 20 targets.

Cast Wanderwine Prophets by paying {4}{U}{U}.
Wanderwine Prophets enters the battlefield, triggering its champion ability and Inalla.
Resolve the Inalla trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Wanderwine Prophets with haste.

Resolve the nontoken Wanderwine Prophets trigger from step 2, choosing not to exile anything.

The Wanderwine Prophets token leaves the battlefield, returning the nontoken Wanderwine Prophets from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 until satisfied.
When the nontoken wanderwine Prophets enters the battlefield, it triggers Inalla and Wanderwine Prophets.
Resolve Inalla's trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Wanderwine Prophets.
Token copy of Wanderwine Prophets enters the battlefield, championing original Wanderwine Prophets.
Resolve the Wanderwine Prophets trigger, does nothing.
Move to combat.
Declare token copy of Wanderwine Prophets as attacker.
Deal combat damage with Wanderwine Prophets.
Token copy of Wanderwine Prophets triggers, causing you to sacrifice itself and take an extra turn after this one.
Token copy of Wanderwine Prophets leaves the battlefield, returning Wanderwine Prophets to the battlefield from exile.
Repeat step 2 to 5.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat from step 14.

Repeat from step 3 for each remaining trigger.
If needed, cast Echo of Eons from your graveyard for its flashback cost by paying {2}{U}, causing each player to discard their hands and draw seven cards.
Repeat from step 2.

combos.description:
Cast Spellseeker, stacking Inalla's trigger under Spellseeker's ETB trigger.

When the token ETBs, tutor Unearth to your hand.
Unearth Spellseeker, leaving {B}{B} floating.
Shortcut resolving both Inalla's trigger and Spellseeker's ETB, tutoring for Burnt Offering and Finale of Promise, leaving {B} floating.
Cast Burnt Offering, sacrificing Spellseeker and adding {B}{R}{R}.
Use that mana to cast Finale of Promise with X=1 targeting Unearth and Culling the Weak.
Sacrifice a Spellseeker token to Culling the Weak for {B}{B}{B}{B} and Unearth Spellseeker.
Resolve Spellseeker's ETB and Inalla's trigger, tutoring Entomb and Reanimate into hand.
Entomb and then Reanimate Archaeomancer, leaving {B} floating.
Resolve Archaeomancer's ETB, returning Burnt Offering from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Burnt Offering on Archaeomancer, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Inalla trigger from when Archaeomancer ETB'd and return Reanimate to your hand, leaving {B}{B}{B} floating.
Reanimate Archaeomancer and resolve the Inalla trigger, retrieving Burnt Offering and FInale of promise, {B} floating.
Sacrifice Archaeomancer to Burnt Offering, adding {R}{R}{B}{B}.
Cast Finale of Promise with X=1 targeting Entomb and Reanimate.
Entomb Shallow Grave and Reanimate Archaeomancer, {B} floating.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger returning Burnt Offering from your graveyard to your hand.
Sacrifice Archaeomancer to Burnt Offering, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Inalla trigger, making a token copy of Archaeomancer with haste and leaving {B}{B}{B} floating.
Return Shallow Grave with the token copy's ETB.
Cast Shallow Grave targeting Archaeomancer, leaving {B} floating.
Repeat steps 20-24 for infinite hasty Archaeomancers.

When Rot Hulk enters, it and Necroduality trigger.
Resolve the Rot Hulk trigger, returning Repository Skaab from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Repository Skaab enters, it and Necroduality trigger.
Resolve the Repository Skaab trigger, sacrificing it.
When Repository Skaab is exploited, Repository Skaab triggers, causing you to return an instant or sorcery from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Necroduality trigger, creating a token copy of Repository Skaab.
When the token Repository Skaab enters, it triggers, sacrificing Rot Hulk.
When Rot Hulk is exploited, Repository Skaab triggers, causing you to return an instant or sorcery from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Necroduality trigger from step 2, creating a token copy of Rot Hulk.
When the token Rot Hulk enters, it triggers, returning Rot Hulk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing any other creature.
Because the creature is a Food due to Ygra, when it dies, Camellia and Ygra trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Camellia trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

results: Return all permanents opponents control to their owner's hand
combos.description:
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast an artifact by paying {0}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning Sol Ring to your hand.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Sol Ring by paying {1}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning the artifact cast in step 3 to your hand.
Repeat.

Play Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it, Greensleeves, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Greensleeves trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Greensleeves trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

Cast Malignus by paying {3}{R}{R}.
When Malignus enters the battlefield, Warstorm Surge triggers, dealing an amount of damage equal to twice Malignus' power to an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

Activate Nuka-Cola Vending Machine by paying {1} and tapping it, creating two Food artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Foods, untapping Nuka-Cola Vending Machine.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Food, adding {C}{C}.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Foods.

results: Infinitely large creature until end of turn
Infinite untap of creatures you control
Infinite mana creatures you control can produce
combos.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: Umbral Mantle attached to Deathbloom Ritualist.

combos.description:
Cast any noncreature spell from your hand by paying its mana cost.
Dovescape triggers, exiling the spell, causing you to cast the spell without paying its mana cost, and creating a number of 1/1 Bird creature tokens equal to the spell's mana value.
Repeat step 2.

results: Put all lands with a basic land type from your library onto the battlefield tapped
combos.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Lotus Cobra and Felidar Retreat trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

Activate Slimefoot by paying {4}.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Slimefoot's ability.
Resolve both Slimefoot abilities, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing both Saproling tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Slimefoot triggers twice, dealing 2 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain two life.
Repeat.

results: Each opponent with an even life total loses the game
combos.description:
Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, causing it to deal lethal damage to each player with an even life total and nearly lethal damage to each player with an odd life total.
You cannot lose the game due to Platinum Angel.
combos.prerequisites: Heartless Hidetsugu does not have summoning sickness.

combos.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by  sacrificing a Zombie creature.
Wilhelt triggers, creating a 3/3 Zombie token with no abilities due to Poppet Factory.
Resolve the ability from step 1.
Repeat.

Activate Trazyn using Hedron Archive's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of any nonlegendary creature you control that has power 1 or greater with haste.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Kiki-Jiki triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the creature token's power.
Repeat.

Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

Cast Activated Sleeper by paying {2}{B}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
Activated Sleeper enters the battlefield, targeting Karmic Guide.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Activated Sleeper, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Activated Sleeper trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, targeting Activated Sleeper.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Karmic Guide, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Twilight Drover by paying {2}{W} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Spirit token, adding {W}.
When the Spirit dies, Twilight Drover triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Twilight Drover.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Spirit token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Spirit dies, Twilight Drover triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Twilight Drover.
Repeat.

Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, causing you to gain seven life and put Approach of the Second Sun into your library seventh from the top.
Cast Drawn from Dreams by paying {2}{U}{U}, looking at the top seven cards of your library, putting Approach of the Second Sun and any other card into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, causing you to win the game.

Activate Trazyn using Sceptre of Eternal Glory's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Trazyn.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.

combos.description:
Cast Gray Merchant either from your hand by paying {3}{B}{B} or from the top of your library by paying 5 life.
When Gray Merchant enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Gray Merchant.
When Gray Merchant dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Gray Merchant from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: Your life total is at least 6 if Gray Merchant is on the top of your library, or you have {3}{B}{B} available otherwise.

combos.description:
Cast Relm's Sketching by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Relm's Sketching, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Relm's Sketching, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.

results: Infinite copies of instant or sorcery spells you cast
Infinite mana nonland permanents you control can produce
combos.description:
Cast Bonus Round by paying {1}{R}{R} and let it resolve.
Activate nonland permanents by tapping them to add at least {1}{U}{U}.
Cast Dramatic Reversal by paying {1}{U}.
Bonus Round triggers, copying Dramatic Resolve.
Let the copy of Dramatic Reversal resolve, untapping all nonland permanents you control.
Cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}.
Bonus Round triggers, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal and choose the original Narset's Reversal as its target.
Let the copy resolve, copying Narset's Reversal and returning it to your hand, and choosing Dramatic Reversal as its target.
Let the remaining Narset's Reversal copy resolve, copying Dramatic Reversal and returning it to your hand.
Activate nonland permanents by tapping them to add at least {1}{U}{U}.
Let the Dramatic Reversal copy resolve, untapping all nonland permanents you control.
Repeat from step 3.

Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Druid Class
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.
combos.prerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.

combos.description:
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Karmic Guide.
Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Preston.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning any creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Preston trigger from step 2, creating a token copy of Karmic Guide that is a 0/1 white Illusion.
The Karmic Guide token enters the battlefield, returning the nontoken Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

results: Infinite untap of permanents you control
Infinite mana permanents you control can produce
combos.description:
Activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding {U}{B}.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping Dimir Aqueduct.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Repeat any number of times.

Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Renegade Rallier.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Renegade Rallier, adding one mana of any color.
When Renegade Rallier dies, Saffi triggers, returning Renegade Rallier from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Renegade Rallier enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Cauldron Familiar, as it is a Food due to Ygra, and another Food, targeting Witch's Oven.
Holding priority, activate Witch's Oven by tapping it and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, creating a Food token.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability, untapping Witch's Oven.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a tapped Food, returning Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature you control, adding {1}.
When the creature dies, Yedora triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Activate the creature by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Hauntwoods Shrieker by paying {1}{G}, turning the creature face-up.
Repeat.

results: Infinite card draw at the beginning of the next upkeep
Infinite draw triggers at the beginning of the next upkeep
combos.description:
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.
combos.prerequisites: You have a way to gain life.

results: Infinite +1/+1 counters on an infinite number of creature tokens
combos.description:
Cast Writhing Chrysalis by paying {2}{R}{G}.
Writhing Chrysalis and Ulalek trigger.
Holding priority, activate Abstruse Archaic by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Ulalek's trigger.
Resolve the copied Ulalek trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} and creating a copy of the Writhing Chrysalis spell, Writhing Chrysalis's trigger, and Ulalek's trigger.
Resolve the copied Ulalek trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} and creating a copy of at least two Writhing Chrysalis spells, at least two Writhing Chrysalis's triggers, and Ulalek's trigger.
Resolve a Writhing Chrysalis trigger, creating two Eldrazi Spawn tokens.
Activate two Eldrazi Spawn tokens by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from 5 any number of times.
Once you have infinite copies of the spells and triggers, you can resolve them all, activate any number of Eldrazi Spawn tokens, and trigger all Writhing Chrysalis's final abilities.

Declare Alpharael as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing the defending player to lose half their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Archfiend of Despair triggers, causing the opponent to lose the remainder of their life total.
combos.prerequisites: A nonland permanent has left the battlefield this turn, or a spell has been warped this turn.

combos.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat

Fetch a land using Myriad Landscape.
When the fetched land enters, Rampaging Baloths and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Rampaging Baloths trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Rampaging Baloths triggers.
Repeat from step 5.
combos.prerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Myriad Landscape.
There are two basic land cards in your library that share a basic land type.

combos.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Timestream Navigator with haste.
Activate the Timestream Navigator token by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it on the bottom of your library from the battlefield, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nontoken creature without a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: You control another nontoken creature without a -1/-1 counter on it.

combos.description:
Cast Siren's Ruse by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Siren's Ruse, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Siren's Ruse, blinking Naru Meha.
Repeat from step 3.
combos.prerequisites: There are legal target(s) for Siren's Ruse.

combos.description:
Give Hornet Nest indestructible by any method.
Deal damage to Hornet Nest.
Hornet Nest triggers, creating at least one 1/1 Insect creature token.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Warstorm Surge, causing the Insect to deal one damage to Hornet Nest.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Blood Celebrant by paying {B} and 1 life, adding {B}
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.
combos.prerequisites: Pact Weapon attached to a creature you control.

results: Put most creature cards from your library onto the battlefield
combos.description:
Activate Horseshoe Crab by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Horseshoe Crab by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the persist or undying creature.
When the creature dies, its persist or undying ability triggers if it doesn't have a -1/-1 counter or +1/+1 counter on it respectively, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if the creature didn't have flying.
Resolve the persist or undying trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a -1/-1 counter or a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if the creature is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as a Food due to Ygra, Experimental Confectioner's second ability and Ygra trigger.
Resolve the Experimental Confectioner trigger, causing you to create a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

Cast Nexus of Fate by paying {5}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Nexus of Fate into your library.
Declare Zethi as an attacker.
Zethi's second ability triggers, creating a copy of Mystical Tutor and causing you to pay {U} to cast it.
Resolve the copy of Mystical Tutor, causing you to search your library for Nexus of Fate and put it on top of your library.
Move to your extra turn, causing you to draw Nexus of Fate during your draw step.
Repeat.

Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it trigger, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Animate Dead to it.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, targeting Dance of the Dead.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Dance of the Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it trigger, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, targeting Animate Dead.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

Attack with the creatures to deal at least six combat damage to a player, triggering Old Gnawbone's ability, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Before the end of your combat phase, activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, to add {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} to untap all creatures you control, give them trample, lifelink, and haste and to get an additional combat phase and an additional main phase after that.
End the combat phase.
Repeat.

Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the additional creature.
When the creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard with zero +1/+1 counters due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

results: You control one opponent on each of their turns
combos.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {6} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Mindslaver.
Activate the Mindslaver token by paying {4}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to gain control of target player during their next turn.
Repeat during each of your turns.

Activate the mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding {U}.
Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping the mana-producing creature.
Repeat.

results: Infinite copies of abilities you control on the stack
combos.description:
Cast Spawn-Gang Commander by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Ulalek and Spawn-Gang Commander trigger.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Ulalek's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Ulalek's trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy the Spawn-Gang Commander spell, then Ulalek's trigger and Spawn-Gang Commander's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Spawn-Gang Commander's trigger, creating three 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate two Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 4 any number of times.
Once you have infinite {C} and Eldrazi Spawn tokens, you may sacrifice them to Spawn-Gang Commander to deal infinite damage to any target(s), and you may resolve all copies of the Spawn-Gang Commander spell.

results: Infinite mana lands you control can produce
Infinite untap of lands you control
combos.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Archaeomancer and Great Whale.
When Archaeomancer and Great Whale enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
If you control seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Great Whale.

Cast Siren's Ruse by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Siren's Ruse, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Siren's Ruse, blinking Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.
combos.prerequisites: There are legal target(s) for Siren's Ruse.

results: Infinite tapped creature tokens with haste
combos.description:
Tap Kiki-Jiki to make a token copy of Fatestitcher with haste.
Tap the Fatestitcher token to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat for infinite ETB and tapped creature tokens with haste.

Cause Spiteful Sliver to take damage by any method.
Spiteful Sliver triggers, dealing damage to an opponent.
Guilty Conscience triggers, dealing damage to Spiteful Sliver.
Repeat from step 2.

results: Infinite copies of artifacts you control
Infinite creature copies of artifacts you control
combos.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Phyrexian Triniform that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Phyrexian Triniform, adding {C}{C}.
When Phyrexian Triniform dies, it triggers, creating three 3/3 Golem artifact creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Golems, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use Urza to make infinite copies of any artifacts you control.

results: Infinite untap of basic lands you control
Reduce the toughness of creatures opponents control to 0
combos.description:
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature, untapping a basic land you control.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Ruthless Knave's first ability by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing a creature, creating two Treasure tokens and two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature, untapping a basic land you control.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you may use them to activate Ruthless Knave's second ability.

Cast Abdel Adrian for its mana cost.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it exiles Lumbering Battlement until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Abdel Adrian's ETB.
When Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, Werefox Bodyguard is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it exiles Abdel Adrian until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Werefox Bodyguard's ETB.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Lumbering Battlement is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Lumbering Battlement enters, it exiles Werefox Bodyguard until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lumbering Battlement's ETB.
When Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
combos.prerequisites: Werefox Bodyguard must be exiled by Lumbering Battlement, and Abdel Adrian must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
combos.manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand

results: Infinite mana artifacts you control can produce
Infinite untap of artifacts you control
combos.description:
Activate Tezzeret's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, targeting Sol Ring and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Holding priority, activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Tezzeret's ability, targeting Sol Ring and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Resolve the copy of Tezzeret's ability, untapping Sol Ring and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.

results: Prevent all damage that would be dealt to you
combos.description:
Whenever damage would be dealt to you, Pariah causes that damage to be redirected to the creature it's attached to.
Vigor will then prevent the damage and put that many +1/+1 counters on that creature instead.

Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Temur Charger.
When Temur Charger dies, Yedora triggers, returning Temur Charger from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Temur Charger by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Temur Charger's morph ability by revealing a green card from your hand, turning Temur Charger face up.
Temur Charger triggers, giving target creature trample until end of turn.
Repeat.

results: Return any number of creatures to their owners' hands
Return any creature to its owner's hand when it enters the battlefield
combos.description:
Activate three lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Soratami Mirror Mage by paying {3} and returning the three lands from the battlefield to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Sakura-Tribe Scout.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 1.
Resolve all Soratami Mirror-Mage abilities, returning any number of creatures from the battlefield to their owners' hands.
combos.prerequisites: You control up to three lands that enter the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {3}.

combos.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ornithopter.
Activate Salvager of Ruin by sacrificing it, returning Ornithopter from your graveyard to your hand.

Bloodchief Ascension triggers, causing that player to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.

Cast a copy of All Aboard by paying {U}, targeting Biblioplex Tomekeeper.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve All Aboard, blinking Biblioplex Tomekeeper.
When Biblioplex Tomekeeper enters, it triggers, causing Skycoach Conductor to become prepared.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

Play Simic Growth Chamber.
Kodama of the East Tree, Sakashima the Impostor, and Simic Growth Chamber trigger.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Simic Growth Chamber onto the battlefield.
Sakashima the Impostor and Simic Growth Chamber trigger.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor token's trigger, putting Simic Growth Chamber onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Simic Growth Chamber trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

Cast Quasiduplicate by paying {1}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Brudiclad triggers, creating a 2/1 Phyrexian Myr creature token, then choosing to have all tokens you control become copies of the Combat Celebrant token.
Declare one of the Combat Celebrant copy as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks.
The Combat Celebrant copy triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it trigger, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Animate Dead to it.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, targeting Dance of the Dead.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Dance of the Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it trigger, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, targeting Animate Dead.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Al Bhed Salvagers, Pawn of Ulamog and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog ability, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.

combos.description:

Repeat from step 2.

combos.description:
Play a nonartifact land.
Tireless Tracker, Kodama, and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, if the land enters the battlefield untapped, activate the nonartifact land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning another nonartifact land to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating a Clue token.
The Clue enters the battlefield, triggering Kodama, putting a nonartifact land onto the battlefield from your hand.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Tireless Tracker and Cloudstone Curio.
Repeat from step 4.

Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.

When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Scaled Herbalist
Repeat.

combos.description:

Activate Despotic Scepter by tapping it, destroying Nefarious Lich.
When Nefarious Lich leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing its controller to lose the game.

Play Golgari Rot Farm. When it enters untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel, Golgari Rot Farm and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Oracle of Mul Daya.
Because of the additional Oracle of Mul Daya token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

When the Forest enters the battlefield, Embodiment of Insight triggers, causing the Forest to become a 3/3 Elemental creature with haste in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Activate the Elemental by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

results: Infinite mana lands you control can produce
combos.description:
Activate a permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {1} and tapping it, creating three token copies of Felidar Guardian that are 1/1 Balloons with haste.
When the Felidar Guardian tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, blinking the mana-producing permanent, The Jolly Balloon Man, and up to one other permanent you control.
Repeat.

Activate Blasting Station by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as a Food due to Ygra, Experimental Confectioner's second ability triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Rat creature token.
When the Rat enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

results: Gain control of all permanents until end of turn
combos.description: Cast Broadcast Takeover by paying {2}{R}{R}{R}, causing you to gain control of all permanents opponents control until end of turn (as they're all artifacts due to Mycosynth Lattice), untap them and give them haste.

Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of a nonlegendary creature whose base power is equal to or greater than its toughness with haste.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Warstorm Surge triggers, dealing damage equal to the creature token's power to the creature token.
The creature token dies as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness, triggering Kiki-Jiki, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

Cast Malignus by paying {3}{R}{R}.
When Malignus enters the battlefield, Warstorm Surge triggers, dealing an amount of damage equal to twice Malignus' power to an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another nontoken non-Human creature
When the creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: You control another nontoken non-Human creature with base toughness 2 or greater.

combos.description:
Cast Unearth by paying {B}, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}. 
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Unearth.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Unearth, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Unearth copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding one mana of any color.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Semblance Anvil.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding one mana of any color.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Semblance Anvil.
Repeat.

Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a creature without flying.
When the creature dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Solemnity.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken creature that does not have flying.

combos.description:
Activate Budoka Gardener by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Budoka Gardener.
Activate the land and another land by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning a land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping another land.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites:
You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
You control a mana-producing land.

results: Infinite tapped creature tokens for opponents
combos.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Rendmaw, adding {C}{C}.
When Rendmaw dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Rendmaw from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Rendmaw enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each player to create a tapped 2/2 Bird creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Bird, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

Cast Abdel Adrian from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and command tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Lagrella and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Restoration Angel returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Restoration Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and re-enters the battlefield, causing Lagrella to return from exile to the battlefield, and triggering both Lagrella and Abdel Adrian's abilities.
Resolve the Lagrella trigger, exiling Restoration Angel until Lagrella leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Lagrella and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat from step 3.
combos.manaNeeded: {4}{W} plus enough mana to pay for command tax, if applicable

combos.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters the battlefield, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Prosperous Innkeeper trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.
combos.prerequisites: You have a way to gain life.

combos.description:
Cast a copy of Channel by paying {G}{G}.
Activate the ability granted by Channel by paying 1 life, adding {C}.
Repeat step 2 as desired.
Cast Exsanguinate by paying {B}{B} and all remaining available mana, causing each opponent to lose a significant amount of life and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.

results: Put all lands with a basic land type from your library onto the battlefield tapped
combos.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control.
If the creature was an Elemental, Omnath triggers, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Resolve the Perilous Forays ability, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Omnath and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Omnath trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping the land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

results: Infinite untap of artifacts and creatures
combos.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, allowing you to pay {2} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability and choose a new target for the copy.
Resolve both copies of Aphetto Alchemist's ability, untapping Aphetto Alchemist and Gilded Lotus.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any artifact or creature instead of Gilded Lotus in step 4.

results: Destroy all permanents opponents control each turn
combos.description:
Cast Spine of Ish Sah by paying at most {2} due to Sami.
When Spine of Ish Sah enters, its first ability triggers, targeting either a permanent an opponent controls or itself if an opponent doesn't control a targetable permanent.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Spine of Ish Sah.
If you targeted Spine of Ish Sah in step 2, the ability will fizzle due to having no legal target.
Spine of Ish Sah's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Spine of Ish Sah trigger from step 2, if applicable.
Repeat from step 1.

At the beginning of your upkeep, Hollowhenge Overlord triggers, creating four 2/2 Wolf creature tokens for each Wolf and/or Werewolf you control due to Primal Vigor and Doubling Season.
Repeat step 1 during each of your upkeeps. You'll create exponentially more Wolves each time assuming the Wolf tokens survive.

results: Infinite mana lands you control can produce
Infinite untap of lands you control
combos.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Peregrine Drake enters, it triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, untapping five lands.
Holding priority, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.
Cast Dream Stalker by paying its mana cost.
When Dream Stalker enters, it triggers twice, returning it and Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: You control up to five lands that can collectively tap to produce at least {3}{U}.

combos.description:
Cast All-Fates Stalker by paying its mana cost.
When All-Fates Stalker enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, causing Icewind Stalwart to return to the battlefield from exile.
When Icewind Stalwart enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking All-Fates Stalker.
All-Fates Stalker leaves and enters the battlefield, triggering All-Fates Stalker's first and second abilities.
Resolve the second All-Fates Stalker trigger, returning Abdel Adrian from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the All-Fates Stalker trigger from step 5, exiling Abdel Adrian until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

During your upkeep, activate Necropotence by paying 1 life, exiling the top card of your library face down.
Repeat step 1 until you have zero life.
Activate Magus of the Mirror by tapping and sacrificing it, exchanging your life total with an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.

results: Opponents can't cast instant spells during their turns
combos.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Azor.
Azor enters the battlefield, preventing opponents from casting instants or sorceries during their next turn.
Repeat during each of your turns.

results: Counter all spells players cast from their hands
combos.description:
Whenever a player casts a spell from their hand, Possibility Storm triggers, exiling the spell and allowing the player to reveal cards from the top of their library until they reveal a spell that shares a type with the exiled spell, and cast it without paying its mana cost.
If the player chooses to cast the spell, Void Mirror triggers, countering that spell since no colored mana was spent to cast it.

Activate Locus of Enlightenment using the Spacecraft's station ability by tapping a creature with power 1 or greater.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying its ability from step 1.
Resolve both Locus of Enlightenment abilities, putting a number of charge counters on it equal to twice the tapped creature's power.
If needed, repeat from step 1 until Locus of Enlightenment has three or more charge counters on it.
Activate Locus of Enlightenment using Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
combos.prerequisites: Untapped creatures you control have total power 2 or greater.

combos.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Timestream Navigator.
Activate token copy of Timestream Navigator by tapping it, paying {2}{U}{U}, and putting it on the bottom of your library, taking an extra turn after this one.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.

results: Infinite mana lands you control can produce
Infinite untap of lands you control
combos.description:
Declare any creature with power 7 or greater that cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent and Hellkite Charger if it isn't the aforementioned creature as attackers.
Shriekwood Devourer and Hellkite Charger trigger.
Resolve the Shriekwood Devourer trigger, untapping at least seven lands.
Holding priority, activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.

Give an opponent's creature indestructible, if needed.
Activate a Treasure token by sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Mayhem Devil triggers, dealing 1 damage to the indestructible creature.
If the creature has less than 0 toughness, Magmatic Galleon's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Angelic Renewal triggers, causing you to sacrifice Angelic Renewal and return Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Angelic Renewal from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

Sacrifice Lurrus to Phyrexian Altar, generating {B}.
Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Lurrus to the battlefield.
With Lurrus' ability, recast Kaya's Ghostform onto Lurrus.

Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Artist's Talent's first ability triggers. Choose not to discard a card.
Repeat

Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast a creature card from your hand.
Cast a creature card by paying its mana cost.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning the creature cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

Cast Appa, Steadfast Guardian by paying {W}{W}.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Appa, Loyal Sky Bison.
Cast Appa, Loyal Sky Bison from exile by paying {0}.
Appa, Steadfast Guardian triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Appa, Loyal Sky Bison enters, it triggers, airbending Appa, Steadfast Guardian.
Cast Appa, Steadfast Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning one of the lands from the battlefield to your hand, untapping the other land.
Play the land returned to your hand in step 2.
When the land enters the battlefield, Kodama and each Scute Swarm you control trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Resolve the first Scute Swarm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers.
Holding priority, activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning one of the lands from the battlefield to your hand, untapping the other land.
Resolve the Kodama trigger from step 7, putting the land returned to your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, each Scute Swarm you control triggers.
Repeat from step 6.

results: Return all instant and sorcery cards from your graveyard to your hand
combos.description:
Cast Culling the Weak by paying {B} and sacrificing Scholar of the Ages, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Cast Corpse Dance by paying {2}{B}, returning Scholar of the Ages from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Culling the Weak and Corpse Dance to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

Activate Lightning-Rig Crew by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating at least one Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping it and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Lightning-Rig Crew.
Repeat.

Cast Shrieking Drake by paying one mana.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Oboro, Palace in the Clouds from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, Lotus Cobra triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's second ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, triggering itself, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

results: Infinitely large creature until end of turn
combos.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing a Food.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure artifact token, a tapped Clue artifact token and a tapped Food artifact token.
Resolve the ability from step 1.
Repeat.

Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: You control an additional creature.

combos.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Scytheclaw attached.
Scytheclaw triggers, causing the opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Archfiend of Despair triggers, causing the opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Harnfel by discarding a card, exiling the top two cards of your library and allowing you to cast them this turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {1}.
The Vision and Scarlet Witch triggers, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Enthusiastic Mechanaut.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Fateful Discovery triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Fateful Discovery trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library
Repeat

Activate a mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting the mana-producing creature.
Ertha Jo triggers, copying The Jolly Balloon Man's ability, targeting Sparring Mummy.
Resolve the copy of The Jolly Balloon Man's ability, creating a token copy of Sparring Mummy that is a 1/1 Balloon with haste.
When Sparring Mummy enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping The Jolly Balloon Man.
Resolve the Jolly Ballon Man ability from step 2, creating a token copy of the mana-producing creature that is a 1/1 Balloon with haste.
Activate the mana-producing creature token by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

results: Put a selection of permanent cards from your hand onto the battlefield
combos.description:
Play the nonartifact permanent in your hand.
When it enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio and both copies of Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the other nonartifact permanent from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the first Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting the permanent you returned in step 3 from your hand onto the battlefield.
When that permanent enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio and the second Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the permanent you played in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger from step 5, declining to use it unless desired.
Resolve the remaining Kodama of the East Tree trigger from step 2, putting the permanent you returned in step 6 from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times.
This combo results in Infinite ETB and Infinite LTB if a permanent involved is a creature, and/or Infinite landfall triggers if it is a land.

During your draw step, Archmage Ascension allows you to search your library for Nexus of Fate, reveal it and put it into your hand.
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying {5}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Nexus of Fate into your library.
Repeat each turn.

results: Infinite combat damage to one opponent
Infinite mana lands you control can produce
Infinite untap of lands you control
combos.description:
Declare Great Whale and Moon-Circuit Hacker as attackers.
When they aren't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Thousand-Faced Shadow's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{U} and returning Moon-Circuit Hacker from the battlefield to your hand, putting Thousand-Faced Shadow onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Thousand-Faced Shadow enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a token copy of Great Whale that is tapped and attacking.
When the Great Whale token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Moon-Circuit Hacker's ninjutsu ability by paying {U} and returning Thousand-Faced Shadow from the battlefield to your hand, putting Moon-Circuit Hacker onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
Deal combat damage using the Great Whale tokens, dealing infinite combat damage to the defending opponent.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana.

At the beginning of your end step, Artificer Class triggers, creating a token copy of Myr Battlesphere.
The Myr Battlesphere token enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Myr creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing the Myr Battlesphere token and sacrificing the four Myr tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

Activate Evereth by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Thran Vigil triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Evereth ability from step 1.
Repeat.

Cast Windfall by paying {2}{U}, causing each player to discard their hand and then draw a number of cards equal to the greatest number of cards a player discarded this way.
Kederekt Parasite triggers for each card drawn this way, giving each opponent a poison counter for each card they drew.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters
combos.prerequisites: You control a red permanent.

results: Infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control
Win the game at the beginning of your next upkeep
combos.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

Play Golgari Rot Farm. When it enters, Tiller Engine, Golgari Rot Farm and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Golgari Rot Farm.
Holding priority, activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad of the Ilysian Grove.
Because of the additional Dryad of the Ilysian Grove token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn

combos.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Hallowed Spiritkeeper, adding {C}{C}.
Hallowed Spiritkeeper dies, creating at least four 1/1 Spirit creature tokens that enter with vigilance counters on them.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Spirit token, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing vigilance counters from three Spirit tokens, causing yourself to mill three cards and returned Hallowed Spiritkeeper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Shuri.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Shuri.
Repeat.

Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Melira.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

Cast the extra turn spell from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Displace from your graveyard by paying its mana cost, blinking Hades and causing it to re-enter the battlefield as Emet-Selch.
When Emet-Selch enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the extra turn spell, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your upkeep during your extra turn, Emet-Selch triggers, transforming itself into Hades.
Repeat.

Cast Doomsday Excruciator by paying six {B}.
When Doomsday Excruciator enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling all but the bottom six cards of each library.
Cast Shared Trauma by paying {B}, and then choosing to pay an additional {6}, milling the remainder of each library.
Move to the next opponent's turn, causing them to lose the game due to attempting to draw from an empty library.
Repeat step 4 for each remaining opponent.

Play Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it, Mole Man, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Mole Man trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it and Mole Man trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Skyshroud Ranger.
Repeat.

Declare your commander as an attacker, attacking an opponent unable to block it.
Sovereigns of Lost Alara's exalted and second abilities trigger.
Resolve Sovereigns of Lost Alara's exalted trigger, giving your commander +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve Sovereigns of Lost Alara's second ability, searching your library for Colossification, putting it onto the battlefield attached to your commander, and shuffling your library.
Deal combat damage with your commander.
The opponent that was dealt damage loses the game due to being dealt at least twenty-one combat damage by your commander.

Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating three 2/2 Spawn artifact creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Spawn, adding {1}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing two Spawns, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

results: Infinite mana lands you control can produce
Infinite untap of lands you control
combos.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Pinnacle Monk and Peregrine Drake
When Pinnacle Monk and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Pinnacle Monk trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.

results: Near-infinitely large creature until end of turn
combos.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Lyse's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat

Cast Earthbending Student by paying its mana cost
When Earthbending Student enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.

combos.description:

 You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control if you have a way to give Endbringer deathtouch indefinitely.
