When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it, Nesting Dragon, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and Nesting Dragon trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

results: Infinite tapped creature tokens with haste
combos.description:
Tap Kiki-Jiki to make a token copy of Vizier of Tumbling Sands with haste.
Tap the Vizier of Tumbling Sands token to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat for infinite ETB and tapped creature tokens with haste.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Juniper Order Ranger triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and Juniper Order Ranger.
Repeat

Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Dimir Aqueduct onto the battlefield.
Dimir Aqueduct triggers, targeting itself.
With the trigger on the stack, tap Dimir Aqueduct for {U}{B}.
Allow the trigger to resolve, returning Dimir Aqueduct to your hand.
Repeat.

Cast Lightning Crafter by paying {3}{R}.
When Lightning Crafter enters the battlefield, its champion ability triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Lightning Crafter with haste.
When the Lightning Crafter token enters the battlefield, its champion ability triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Lightning Crafter token by tapping it, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Resolve the first champion trigger, exiling Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve the second champion trigger, exiling the Lightning Crafter token.
When the Lightning Crafter token leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

Cast Tainted Strike by paying {B}, giving Syr Konrad +1/+0 and infect until end of turn.
Activate Perpetual Timepiece's second ability by paying {2} and exiling it, shuffling your graveyard into your library.
Syr Konrad triggers for each creature card that left your graveyard this way, giving each opponent that many poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

Fetch a land using Misty Rainforest.
When the fetched land enters, Tireless Tracker and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Tireless Tracker trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Tireless Tracker triggers.
Repeat from step 5.
combos.prerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Misty Rainforest.
Your life total is 2 or higher.

results: Infinitely powerful creature until end of turn
combos.description:
Activate Aerid by paying {6}, creating a Heartwood token and giving Aerid +X/+0 until end of turn.
Activate the Heartwood by tapping it, adding six {R} or six {G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient and Mana Reflection.
Repeat.

Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Agate Instigator, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Agate Instigator triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
combos.prerequisites: Tandem Lookout paired with Agate Instigator.

combos.description:
Cast Lightning Crafter by paying its mana cost.
When Lightning Crafter enters the battlefield, its champion ability and Molten Echoes triggers.
Resolve the Molten Echoes trigger, creating a token copy of Lightning Crafter with haste.
When the Lightning Crafter token enters the battlefiled, its champion ability triggers, exiling the nontoken Lightning Crafter until the token Lightning Crafter leaves the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate the Lightning Crafter token by tapping it, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Resolve the champion ability from step 2, exiling the token Lightning Crafter.
The token Lightning Crafter leaves the battlefield, returning the nontoken Lightning Crafter from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
combos.prerequisites: "Goblin" or "Shaman" chosen with Molten Echoes.

combos.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Cloud Key.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Transplant Theorist triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Transplant Theorist trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Repeat.

Activate Kelpie Guide's first ability by tapping it, targeting Second Wind.
Kelpie Guide triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Kelpie Guide ability, untapping Second Wind.
Activate Second Wind's second ability by tapping it, untapping Kelpie Guide.
Repeat.

Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Kurkesh triggers, causing you to pay {R} to copy Voltaic Key's ability.
Resolve the copy of Voltaic Key's ability, untapping itself.
Repeat.

Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa, Who Shakes the World triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Nissa's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, animating a Forest you control.
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Activate the animated Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Play a land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the Forest it is attached to.
When the Forest token enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Forest token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the Forest it is attached to.
Repeat from step 6.
combos.prerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control a Forest that does not have summoning sickness and that enters the battlefield untapped.

combos.description:
Activate Chromatic Star by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Chromatic Star triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Chromatic Star from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Chromatic Star from your graveyard by paying {1}.
Mirran Spy triggers, untapping Emry.
Repeat.

Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {0}.
Hangarback Walker enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Metastatic Evangel triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Hangarback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature with a coin counter on it.
When the creature dies, Resourceful Defense and Athreos trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting a coin counter on another nontoken creature you control.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature that died in step 1 from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: You control at least two additional nontoken creatures, one of which has a coin counter on it.

combos.description:
Cast Swords to Plowshares by paying {W}, exiling Soul of Eternity and gaining life equal to its power.
Sanguine Bond triggers, causing target opponent whose lifetotal is less than or equal to Soul of Eternity's power to lose life equal to the life you gained.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a Zombie creature.
Wilhelt triggers, creating a 3/3 Zombie token with no abilities due to Poppet Factory.
Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

Play Selesnya Sanctuary. When it enters untapped due to Horizon Explorer, Selesnya Sanctuary and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad of the Ilysian Grove.
Because of the additional Dryad of the Ilysian Grove token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn

results: Put all lands from your hand and library onto the battlefield
combos.description:
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodghast.
When Bloodghast dies, Zimone and Dina triggers, untapping Zimone and Dina.
Resolve the Zimone and Dina ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card and put Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield, and then repeat this process once if you control eight or more lands, putting any other land from your hand onto the battlefield instead.
 When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and Bloodghast trigger.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodghast trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

results: Infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control
combos.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on any creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
The Servo enters the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting a +1/+1 on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers for each +1/+1 counter placed this way.
Resolve all but one Animation Module trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the final Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Shield Sphere
When Shield Sphere dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Shield Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Shield Sphere from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, causing it to enter with a +1/+1 counter due to Arwen.
When Basking Broodscale enters, it triggers, creating an 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter due to Arwen.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Reyhan triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating an 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter due to Arwen.
Repeat from step 3.

results: Destroy all noncreature permanents opponents control
combos.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Woodfall Primus, adding one mana of any color.
Woodfall Primus's persist ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield with no counters on it due to Woodfall Primus's riot ability.
Woodfall Primus enters the battlefield, destroying target noncreature permanent.
Repeat.

Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2}, casting a copy of Noxious Revival without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the Noxious Revival, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.

With Soulherder and a creature based spell recursion effect on the battlefield, cast the extra turn spell.
Move to end step and target the creature with Soulherder's ability.
When creature re-enters the battlefield, target the extra turn spell in your graveyard and return it to your hand, then pass to yourself.
Repeat

results: Infinite copies of abilities you control on the stack
Infinite copies of a specific creature
combos.description:
Cast any other Eldrazi except Drowner of Truth by paying its mana cost, triggering Ulalek.
Holding priority, cast Drowner of Truth by paying {4}{C}{G/U}{G/U}.
Drowner of Truth and Ulalek trigger.
Resolve the Ulalek trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy all spells you control and then copy all activated and triggered abilities you control, ensuring to put Drowner of Truth's trigger on top of Ulalek's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Drowner of Truth's trigger, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the copy of Ulalek's trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy all spells you control and then copy all activated and triggered abilities you control, ensuring to put Drowner of Truth's trigger on top of Ulalek's trigger.
Repeat from step 5.
combos.manaNeeded: {4}{C}{C}{C}{G/U}{G/U} plus enough mana to cast the additional Eldrazi spell

combos.description:
Play Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it, Eusocial Engineering, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Eusocial Engineering trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it and Eusocial Engineering trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

Activate Aetherflux Resevoir by paying 50 life, targeting yourself, but instead preventing the damage and causing you to gain 100 life due to Purity.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Aetherflux Resevoir by paying 50 life, dealing 50 damage to any target.
Repeat step 3 as desired.

Cast Kor Skyfisher without paying its mana cost due to Aluren.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
Felidar Guaridan enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Flameshadow Conjuring.
Holding priority, activate the mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {R}.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking the mana-producing permanent.
Resolve the Flameshadow Conjuring trigger, causing you to pay {R} to create a token copy of Felidar Guardian with haste.
The Felidar Guardian token enters the battlefield, blinking the nontoken Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.

results: Infinite untap of creatures you control
Infinite mana creatures you control can produce
combos.description:
Declare Sun Warriors as an attacker, triggering its ability, adding an amount of {R} equal to the number of creatures you control.
Move to your postcombat main phase. You will not lose the mana due to Leyline Tyrant.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from exile to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Repeat from step 3.

Cast Echo of Eons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing each player to shuffle their hand and graveyard into their library and draw seven cards.
Fate Unraveler triggers for each card your opponent draw this way, giving each opponent seven poison counters.
Cast Echo of Eons from your graveyard for its flashback cost by paying {2}{U}, causing each player to shuffle their hand and graveyard into their library, draw seven cards, and exile Echo of Eons.
Fate Unraveler triggers for each card your opponent draw this way, giving each opponent seven poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar
When Cauldron Familar dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

results: Infinitely large creature until end of turn
Infinite untap of creatures you control
Infinite mana creatures you control can produce
combos.description:
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Alena by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: Umbral Mantle attached to Alena.

combos.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another artifact, adding {C}{C}.
Crime Novelist triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and adding {R}.
Activate Olivia's Attendants by paying {2}{R}, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Olivia's Attendants triggers, creating a Blood token.
Repeat.

results: Infinite card draw at the beginning of the next upkeep
Infinite draw triggers at the beginning of the next upkeep
combos.description:
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Urza's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {R}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Searing Touch, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning it to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

Cast Gray Merchant either from your hand by paying {3}{B}{B} or from the top of your library by paying 5 life.
When Gray Merchant enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Gray Merchant.
When Gray Merchant dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Gray Merchant from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: Your life total is at least 6 if Gray Merchant is on the top of your library, or you have {3}{B}{B} available otherwise.

combos.description:
Cast First Day of Class by paying {1}{R}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, First Day of Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 2

Activate Patrol Signaler by tapping it, adding {W} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Patrol Signaler by paying {W} and untapping it, creating a 1/1 Kithkin Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Echoes of Eternity triggers, creating a copy of the Sensei's Divining Top spell.
Resolve both Sensei's Divining Top spells.
Activate the nontoken Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate the token Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top, and causing you to put the token Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Imotekh the Stormlord triggers if the creature that was returned to your hand was an artifact, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ashnod's Altar ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

Cast Spark Double by paying {3}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a nonlegendary copy of Abdel Adrian.
When Spark Double enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Spark Double leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Glasspool Mimic returns from exile to the battlefield as a copy of Spark Double.
When Glasspool Mimic enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Spark Double until Glasspool Mimic leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Spark Double leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Glasspool Mimic until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Glasspool Mimic leaves the battlefield, Spark Double returns to the battlefield from exile as a nonlegendary copy of Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 2.

Play Gruul Turf. When it enters untapped due to Horizon Explorer, Gruul Turf and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Wayward Swordtooth.
Because of the additional Wayward Swordtooth token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn

combos.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters the battlefield, Hedron Detonator triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Hedron Detonator trigger, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Ob Nixilis triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, and exiling Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library with the ability to cast it from exile until your end step.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {1}.
Prosper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Yuna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.

Cast Young Necromancer by paying {4}{B}.
Young Necromancer enters the battlefield, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Young Necromancer, causing you to mill two cards.
Resolve the Young Necromancer trigger, exiling two cards from your graveyard except Young Necromancer, and returning Young Necromancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

results: Near-infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control
combos.description:
Cast Acererak either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Staff of the Death Magus triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
combos.manaNeeded: {B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable

combos.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying an amount of {E}, sacrificing Greedy Freebooter or Shambling Ghast and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Greedy Freebooter or Shambling Ghast dies, it and Sifter of Skulls trigger.
Resolve the Greedy Freebooter or Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning either Greedy Freebooter or Shambling Ghast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature with a coin counter on it.
When the creature dies, Resourceful Defense and Athreos trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting a coin counter on another nontoken creature you control.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature that died in step 1 from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: You control at least two additional nontoken creatures, one of which has a coin counter on it.

combos.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Season of Growth's first ability triggers, causing you to scry 1.
Arwen Undómiel triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Archaeomancer.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat each turn.

Activate Liliana's third loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, allowing you to cast Zombie spells from your graveyard this turn.
Cast a Zombie from your hand or graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Zombie
Repeat from step 2.

Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking The One Ring.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate The One Ring by tapping it, putting a burden counter on it and causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Repeat.

results: Infinite copies of permanent spells you control
combos.description:
Cast Gitaxian Anatomist by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Gitaxian Anatomist spell three times.
Resolve the first Gitaxian Anatomist spell.
When the Gitaxian Anatomist token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to tap it and put an indestructible counter on Myojin.
Repeat from step 2.

results: Infinite mana lands you control that enter the battlefield untapped can produce
Exile all nonland permanents opponents control
Infinite mana lands you control can produce
combos.description:
Cast Rescue the Foal by paying its mana cost, blinking Felidar Guardian.
Felidar Guardian and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking another permanent you control.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Felidar Guardian that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Felidar Guardian token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking the nontoken Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, dealing damage to each opponent equal to 1.5 times their life total, and dealing no damage to you due to Pariah's Shield.
combos.prerequisites: Each opponent's life total is 2 or greater.

combos.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Changeling Outcast, adding {B}.
Cast Changeling Outcast from your graveyard by paying {B}.

When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it, Mole Man, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Mole Man trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Mole Man trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

results: Infinite mana lands you control can produce
combos.description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting two nonartifact lands from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Amulet of Vigor and Cloudstone Curio trigger twice.
Resolve both Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the lands.
Holding priority, activate the lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}.
Resolve both Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning the lands from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

Cast Chandra's Ignition by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing Malignus to deal damage equal to three times its power to each other creature and each opponent.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

Activate The Walls of Ba Sing Se by tapping it, causing a player to mill thirty cards.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping The Walls of Ba Sing Se.
Repeat as mana allows.

Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Spark Double.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Spark Double.
Activate Spark Double by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Spark Double ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fiend Hunter token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Fiend Hunter token dies, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.

results: Infinite mana lands you control can produce

combos.description:
Declare Yuriko as an attacker.
When it isn't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}{B}{B}.
Activate Palinchron's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{B} and returning Yuriko from the battlefield to your hand, putting Palinchron onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Yuriko's ninjutsu ability by paying {U}{B} and returning Palinchron from the battlefield to your hand, putting Yuriko onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}{B}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

Activate Dakmor Salvage's cycling ability by paying {R} and discarding it.
Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Dakmor Salvage ability, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Zulaport Cutthroat trigger.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

combos.description:

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Jegantha.

When Volcano Hellion enters, it triggers, dealing an arbitarily large amount of damage to you and a creature. The damage that would be dealt to you is dealt to Spitemare instead due to Pariah.

Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.

At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Glorious Protector.
Glorious Protector leaves and enters the battlefield, returning Icewind Stalwart from exile to the battlefield, and triggering both Icewind Stalwart and Glorious Protector's enters-the-battlefield abilities.

Resolve the Icewind Stalwart trigger, blinking Glorious Protector.

When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Welding Jar from your graveyard to your hand.

Resolve the copy of Reiterate, copying the original Reiterate, with the copy targeting the original Reiterate.

Kormus Bell turns all swamps into creatures.
Linvala prevents your opponent' creatures from activating their abilities, including mana abilities.

Fetch a land using Wooded Foothills.
When the fetched land enters, Zendikar's Roil and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Zendikar's Roil trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Zendikar's Roil triggers.
Repeat from step 5.
combos.prerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Wooded Foothills.
Your life total is 2 or higher.

combos.description:
Cast Another Round by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Eternal Witness and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Eternal Witness trigger.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Another Round from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Another Round.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Eternal Witness and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Reveillark.
When Reveillark dies, it triggers, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Reveillark.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Activated Sleeper.
When Activated Sleeper dies, it triggers, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Reveillark.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.

Cast Pirate's Pillage by paying {R} and by discarding a card from your hand.
If you have less than four experience counters, Mizzix triggers, causing you to get an experience counter.
Holding priority, cast Retierate with buyback by paying {R}{R}, creating a copy of Pirate's Pillage and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Pirate's Pillage, causing you to draw two cards and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

results: Infinite copies of permanent spells you control
combos.description:
Cast Kiora's Dambreaker by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Kiora's Dambreaker spell three times.
Resolve the first Kiora's Dambreaker spell.
When the Kiora's Dambreaker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin.
Repeat from step 2.

Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to it.
Walking Ballista triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Michelangelo.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the one-drop creature, adding {B}.
When that creature dies, it and Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel trigger.
Resolve the creature's ability, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel ability, gaining at least one life and causing at least one opponent to lose at least one life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the one-drop creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the token creature, adding one colored mana.
Cast the creature by paying one mana.
Repeat.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature castable for {0}, adding {B}.
When that creature dies, Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER or Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel's emblem triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the sacrificed creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast that creature by paying {0}.
Repeat.

Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Fumulus trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Fumulus trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Activate Evereth by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Gev.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat

Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning any other creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token, then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Activate the Plant by tapping it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

results: Infinite mana lands you control can produce
Put all land cards from your library and graveyard onto the battlefield
combos.description:
Activate any number of other lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
Activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing a land other than Port of Karfell.
Repeat step 2 until you control no other lands except Port of Karfell.
Activate Port of Karfell's second ability by paying {3}{U}{B}{B}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to mill four cards and return Lumra from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Lumra enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Lumra's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Repeat.

results: Nobody can activate the abilites of any permanent on the battlefield
combos.description:
Mycosynth Lattice turns all permanents into artifacts.
Activated abilities can not be activated due to Null Rod.

Play Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it, Sapling Nursery, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sapling Nursery trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Sapling Nursery trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of any nonlegendary creature you control with haste.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Kiki-Jiki triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

Cast Gravecrawler either from your hand or graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters the battlefield, Ayara, Carnival of Souls and The Sibsig Ceremony trigger.
Resolve the Ayara trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Resolve the Sibsig Ceremony trigger, destroying Gravecrawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When the Zombie Druid enters the battlefield, Ayara and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Ayara trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: You control another Zombie if Gravecrawler is in your graveyard.

results: Destroy all creatures opponents control during each turn
combos.description:
During any turn, activate Pyrohemia by paying {R}, dealing 1 damage to each creature and each player.
Each creature your opponents control dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Repeat each turn as desired.
combos.prerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.

combos.description:
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Scaled Herbalist.
Repeat.

Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

results: Infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control
combos.description:
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Walking Ballista.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ornithopter.
Activate Salvager of Ruin by sacrificing it, returning Ornithopter from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Salvager of Ruin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Cast Reset by paying {U}{U}.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback cost by paying {4}{R}{R}, creating a copy of Reset.
Resolve the Reset copy, untapping all lands you control.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Hardened Academic triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1.
Repeat.

Cause an artifact to enter under your control.
When the artifact enters, Quicksmith Genius triggers, causing you to rummage.
Magmakin Artillerist triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure token for each opponent that was dealt damage.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Quicksmith Genius triggers that many times.
Resolve a Quicksmith Genius trigger, causing you to rummage.
Repeat from step 3.
combos.prerequisites:
You have a card in hand.
You can cause an artifact to enter under your control.

results: Infinite card draw for all players
Infinite draw triggers for all players
combos.description:
Activate Faerie Mastermind by paying {3}{U}, causing each player to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers twice for each opponent you have, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
When Eternal Scourge dies, Brenard triggers, exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard and creating a token copy of it that is a 1/1 Food Golem artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Eternal Scourge token, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Eternal Scourge tokens.

results: Infinite creature tokens that are infinitely large
Infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control
combos.description:
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two 1/1 Elemental creture tokens.
The Elementals enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes twice, adding {C}{C} for each Elemental you control.
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite {C}, you may repeat step 3 to give Marath infinite +1/+1 counters, then use them to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

Declare any creature as an attacker, triggering Dawnsire, dealing 100 damage to Raphael.
Raphael triggers, adding 100 {R}.
combos.prerequisites: You control a creature that can attack.

combos.description:
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it on the bottom of your library from the battlefield, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Planar Bridge by paying {8} and tapping it, causing you to search your library for Timestream Navigator and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

Activate Aethergeode Miner by paying {E}{E}, blinking it.
When Aethergeode Miner enters the battlefield, Metastatic Evangel and Aetherstorm Roc trigger.
Resolve the Aetherstorm Roc trigger, causing you to get {E}.
Resolve the Metastatic Evangel trigger, causing you to proliferate and get {E}.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: You have at least {E}{E}.

combos.description:
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping it and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard this turn.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Emry.
Cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Cast Brain Freeze.
Brain Freeze's storm ability triggers, copying it for each spell cast before it this turn.
Resolve the all the Brain Freeze copies and Brain Freeze, milling any number of players for an arbitrarily large amount.

Cast Infinite Reflection by paying {5}{U}, targeting Biovisionary.
Infinite Reflection enters the battlefield, causing each nontoken creature you control to become a copy of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary you control triggers.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.

Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying an amount of {E}, sacrificing Greedy Freebooter or Impulsive Pilferer and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Greedy Freebooter or Impulsive Pilferer dies, it and Pawn of Ulamog trigger.
Resolve the Greedy Freebooter or Impulsive Pilferer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning either Greedy Freebooter or Impulsive Pilferer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

results: Infinite tapped creature tokens until end of turn
combos.description:
Cast Kiki-Jiki by paying {2}{R}{R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Double Major by paying {U}{G}, creating a non-legendary token copy of Kiki-Jiki.
Activate the untapped non-legendary Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself.
Repeat step 3.

Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a Food.
Camellia triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Food artifact token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar
When Cauldron Familar dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

Activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life.
Repeat step 1 until Greven has power 21 or greater due to its first ability.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Greven. The opponent loses the game due to being dealt 21 or more combat damage from your commander.

Activate PuPu UFO by tapping it, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping PuPu UFO.
Repeat.

Cast Justiciar's Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Mnemonic Wall and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Mnemonic Wall trigger.
Resolve the Mnemonic Wall trigger, returning Justiciar's Portal from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Justiciar's Portal.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Mnemonic Wall and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion, adding {B}.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Bloodsoaked Champion from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion, adding {1}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Cast Not Dead After All by paying {B}, targeting Eternal Witness.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Eternal Witness, adding {B}.
When Eternal Witness dies, it and any Wicked Role tokens that may be attached to it trigger.
If applicable, resolve the Wicked Role trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped, and attaching a Wicked Role token to it.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Not Dead After All to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

Activate Araumi by tapping it and exiling cards from your graveyard equal to the number of opponent you have, giving Vizier of Tumbling Sands encore until end of turn.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands' encore ability by paying {2}{U} and exiling it, causing you to create a token copy of it with haste for each opponent you have.
Activate a Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping a different Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Mesmeric Orb triggers, causing you to mill a card.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Moldervine Reclamation, Golgari Germination and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card.
Resolve the Golgari Germination ability, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Moldervine Reclamation triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.

combos.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token.
The Pincher enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, triggering Grinding Station, untapping it.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Pincher.
When the Pincher dies, Summoning Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability, causing target player to mill three cards.
Repeat.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Myr Battlesphere, adding {1}.
Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Myr creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing three Myr tokens, adding {3}.
Repeat.

Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, giving Steelfin Whale an activated ability until end of turn.
Activate Steelfin Whale by tapping it, returning the free artifact from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast that artifact by paying {0}.
When that artifact enters the battlefield, it triggers Steelfin Whale, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.
combos.prerequisites: Steelfin Whale does not have summoning sickness.

combos.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat

results: Infinite mana nonland permanents you control can produce
Infinite untap of nonland permanents you control
combos.description:
Activate all mana producing nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Dramatic Reversal by paying {1}{U}.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, creating a copy of Dramatic Reversal and returning Dramatic Reversal to your hand.
Activate Errant by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Dramatic Reversal copy.
Resolve the first Dramatic Reversal copy, untapping all nonland permanents you control.
Activate all mana producing nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Repeat from step 4.

results: Infinite copies of creatures you control
combos.description:
Cast Electroduplicate by paying its mana cost targeting the creature that can recur spells.
When you cast that spell, Spinerock Tyrant triggers, copying Electroduplicate and choosing Spinerock Tyrant as its target.
Resolve the copy of Electroduplicate, creating a Spinerock Tyrant token.
Resolve the original Electroduplicate, creating a token copy of the spell recursion creature.
When that token enters, it triggers, returning Electroduplicate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 1 one additional time, resulting in a total of five Spinerock Tyrants.
Cast the spell that creates a Treasure token by paying its mana cost, targeting any creature.
Each copy of Spinerock Tyrant triggers, copying that spell once for each Spinerock Tyrant you control.
Resolve all copies of that spell, creating at least one Treasure token each time.
Activate those Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding one mana per Treasure.
Cast Electroduplicate by paying its mana cost targeting the spell recursion creature.
When you cast that spell, each copy of Spinerock Tyrant triggers, copying Electroduplicate once for each Spinerock Tyrant and choosing the spell recursion creature once and Spinerock Tyrant as each additional spell's target.
Resolve all copies of that spell, creating two copies of the spell recursion creature and additional copies of Spinerock Tyrant.
When the first spell recursion creature token enters, it triggers, returning the spell that creates Treasure from your graveyard to your hand.
 When the second spell recursion creature token enters, it triggers, returning Electroduplicate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 7.

Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa's ability to sacrifice a creature and create at least 1 zombie.
Thornbite Staff allows Ghoulcaller Gisa to untap with her ability.
Sacrifice the zombie to Ghoulcaller Gisa again to create 3 zombies.
Thornbite Staff untaps Ghoulcaller Gisa again.
Sacrifice a zombie to Phyrexian Altar to add {B} to your mana pool.
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa's ability to sacrifice a zombie and create 3 zombies.
Thornbite Staff untaps Ghoulcaller Gisa again.
Repeat.

Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Timestream Navigator with haste.
If you do not have the city's blessing, the Timestream Navigator token's ascend ability triggers, causing you to get the city's blessing for the rest of the game.
Activate the Timestream Navigator token by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

Cast Abdel Adrian either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Restoration Angel until Abedl Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Cast Siren's Ruse by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Restoration Angel to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Abdel Adrian and Restoration Angel's enter abilities.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Restoration Angel until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Restoration Angel trigger, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 4.
combos.manaNeeded: {5}{U}{W} plus enough mana to pay commander tax, if applicable

results: Infinite mana lands you control can produce
Infinite untap of lands you control
combos.description:
Activate six basic Islands by tapping them, adding six {U}.
Gauntlet of Power triggers six times, adding six {U}.
Cast Palinchron by paying {5}{U}{U}.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping the six Islands and up to one additional land you control.
Activate Palinchron by paying {2}{U}{U}, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Sewer-veillance Cam from your graveyard this turn.
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Sewer-veillance Cam from your graveyard by paying {U}.
When Sewer-veillance Cam enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Sewer-veillance Cam.
Sewer-veillance Cam triggers, untapping the mana-producing creature.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

Cast Earthbending Student by paying its mana cost
When Earthbending Student enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Earthbending Student
When Earthbending Student dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Earthbending Student enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Priest of Gix adding one mana of any color.
Priest of Gix dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Saheeli's Artistry, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Saheeli's Artistry, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Sparring Mummy with haste.
When the Sparring Mummy token enters, it triggers, untapping Kiki-Jiki
Repeat.

Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Scholar of New Horizons.
When Scholar of New Horizons dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Scholar of New Horizons enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

results: Infinite mana lands you control can produce
Put all land cards from your library and graveyard onto the battlefield
combos.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing a land, adding one mana of any color that land could produce.
Repeat step 1 until you have at least {4}{B}{G} available and/or you control no other mana-producing lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers that many times, creating that many creature tokens.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}, sacrificing a creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aftermath Analyst enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing another artifact, which is a Food due to Gourmand's Talent.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

results: Put all land cards from your opponents' libraries onto the battlefield tapped under your control
combos.description:
Play a land card, triggering Dúnedain Rangers and Zendikar's Roil.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil trigger, creating a 2/2 Elemental creature token.
Resolve the Dúnedain Rangers trigger, causing the Ring to tempt you, and causing the Elemental token to become your Ring-bearer.
Sméagol triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Elemental, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Sméagol trigger, causing an opponent to reveal cards from the top of their library until they reveal a land card, then causing you to put the land onto the battlefield tapped under your control, and your opponent to put all other revealed cards into their graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Dúnedain Rangers and Zendikar's Roil trigger.
Repeat from step 2.
NOTE: This combo can be stopped if an opponent runs out of lands in their library, so it is recommended to alternate opponents in between cycles to maximize the amount of iterations.

Play Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it, Greensleeves, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Greensleeves trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and Greensleeves trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

results: Put a selection of creature cards from your library onto the battlefield
combos.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Sisay by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, searching your library for a legendary creature card with mana value less than Sisay's power and putting it onto the battlefield.
When the legendary creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

When Flayer Husk enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 0/0 Phyrexian Germ creature token and attaching Flayer Husk to it.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Flayer Husk, adding {C}{C}.
The Phyrexian Germ dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Salvaging Station, untapping Salvaging Station.
Repeat.

results: Put all lands with a basic land type from your library onto the battlefield tapped
combos.description:

When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping the land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

Fetch a land using Prismatic Vista.
When the fetched land enters, Rampaging Baloths and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Rampaging Baloths trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Rampaging Baloths triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Prismatic Vista.
Your life total is 2 or higher.

combos.description:
Activate Spawnsire of Ulamog by paying {4}, creating four 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nontoken non-Human creature
When the creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yahenni abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.

combos.description:

When the creature dies, its persist or undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter or a +1/+1 counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

results: Put all lands from your hand and library onto the battlefield

Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Skyshroud Ranger.
Resolve the Aesi trigger, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

results: Infinite +1/+1 counters on an infinite number of creature tokens
Infinite +1/+1 counters on Squirrels you control
combos.description:

Camellia's first ability triggers, creating two Foods and two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Resolve the Camellia ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Squirrel you control.
Activate the two Foods by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

combos.description:

At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The Great Synthesis triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its third chapter ability then triggers, causing you to cast Time Stretch and Archaeomancer without paying their mana costs, and then exiling The Great Synthesis and returning it to the battlefield as Jin-Gitaxias.
Resolve Time Stretch, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Resolve the Archaeomancer spell. When it enters, it triggers, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Jin-Gitaxias by paying {3}{U}, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as The Great Synthesis.
When The Great Synthesis enters with a lore counter on it, its first ability triggers, causing you to draw cards equal to the number of cards in your hand and not have a maximum hand size for the rest of the game.
Move to your first extra turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The Great Synthesis triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its second chapter ability then triggers, returning all non-Phyrexian creatures (including Archaeomancer) from the battlefield to their owner's hand.
Repeat from step 1 during your second extra turn
combos.prerequisites: You have at least eight cards in hand.

combos.description:

Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {2}{U}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Gilded Lotus.
Resolve Whim of Volrath, returning it to your hand.

Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
Repeat.

Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from exile to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 3.

Mendicant Core triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy the Scrap Trawler spell, creating a token copy of it.

When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning another artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the token Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}.
When the token Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning the nontoken Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.

Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.

Blazing Sunsteel and The Mycosynth Gardens trigger.

combos.description:

The creature dies, triggering Ghost Lantern, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature it is attached to.

When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.

Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.

Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.

If it has not triggered this turn, Tameshi's first ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve Tameshi's second ability, returning Lotus Bloom from your graveyard to the battlefield.

At the beginning of your upkeep, Replicating Ring triggers, putting a night counter on it. Then, if it has eight or more night counters, remove all of them and create eight Replicating Ring tokens.
Deal combat damage using Obeka. Obeka triggers, causing you to get at least seven upkeep steps after this phase.
Repeat step 1 for each of the additional upkeep steps.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Replicating Ring tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Junji.

Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.

When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

Draw a card.
Human Torch triggers, dealing 1 damage.
Curiosity triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

combos.description:

When Cartouche of Solidarity enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Warrior creature token.
Resolve the ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

Because Soulless Jailer prevents noncreature spells from being cast from exile, no player may cast noncreature spells as permitted by Possibility Storm.

Draw a card, causing you to win the game due to drawing from an empty library.

Resolve the Field of the Dead trigger, creating a token.

Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning one of the lands from the battlefield to your hand, untapping the other land.
Resolve the Kodama trigger from step 7, putting the land returned to your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Field of the Dead triggers, creating a token.
Repeat from step 7.

Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {1}.

Pay {3}{U}{U} to cast Time Warp.

Pass to extra turn.

Rampaging Baloths triggers for each land that enters the battlefield this way.
Resolve the first Rampaging Baloths trigger, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
When the Beast enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.

Activate Marvin using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from Marvin, dealing 1 damage to any target.

Cast Karmic Guide by paying {3}{W}{W}.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Metamorphosis Fanatic trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat form step 2.

Play Golgari Rot Farm. When it enters, Tiller Engine, Golgari Rot Farm and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Golgari Rot Farm.
Holding priority, activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Oracle of Mul Daya.
Because of the additional Oracle of Mul Daya token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.
