combos.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Insidious Roots trigger.
Resolve the Insidious Roots trigger, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

Activate Spawnsire of Ulamog by paying {4}, creating four 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

results: Infinite creature token copies of all noncreature permanents
combos.description:
Cast Phantasmal Image by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Phantasmal Image into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Phantasmal Image dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Astral Dragon, gaining its abilities.
When Phantasmal Image enters, it triggers, creating two token copies of itself, thus creating two copies of Moon with Astral Dragon's abilities, that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to its other types.
Put all but one of the Phantasmal Images into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Phantasmal Image tokens each trigger. Resolve a trigger, creating two token copies of itself, thus creating two copies of Moon with Astral Dragon's abilities, that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 5.

results: Put all lands with a basic land type from your library onto the battlefield tapped
combos.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Rampaging Baloths and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land you control.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

results: Put all lands with a basic land type from your library onto the battlefield tapped

When the land enters the battlefield, Omnath triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Skirk Prospector.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Koll triggers, returning Skirk Prospector from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Skirk Prospector by paying {R}.
Repeat.

Cast the creature card by paying its mana cost.

Activate Trench Behemoth by returning the creature from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Trench Behemoth.
Repeat.

combos.description:

Resolve the Sakura-Tribe Elder ability
Activate Sakura-Tribe Elder by sacrificing it.
When Sakura-Tribe Elder dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Sakura-Tribe Elder from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Resolve the Sakura-Tribe Elder ability
Repeat

Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on Marath.
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Elemental creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Elemental, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

Activate Tree of Perdition by tapping it, causing its toughness to become equal to an opponents life total, and causing that opponent to lose life equal to the difference between their life total and Tree of Perdition's toughness as the ability resolved.
At the beginning of your end step, Blitzwing triggers, causing the opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.

Repeat.

results: Infinite mana Elves you control can produce
Infinite untap of Elves you control
combos.description:

Each Elf tapped this way triggers, untapping it and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Dionus, thus granting a fresh instance of the ability to each Elf you control.

combos.description:

Simic Ascendancy's second ability triggers, putting a growth counter on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Crystalline Crawler.
Repeat until Simic Ascendancy has at least twenty growth counters on it.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy's third ability triggers, causing you to win the game.

Activate Earthcraft by tapping a Saproling, untapping a basic land.
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a Saproling, untapping a basic land.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing a Saproling, putting a +1/+1 counter on Ghave.
Repeat.

combos.description:
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat step 1 until Cryptic Trilobite does not have any +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Skullclamp's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Cryptic Trilobite.
Cryptic Trilobite dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness, triggering its undying ability and Skullclamp.

Resolve the Skullclamp trigger, causing you to draw two cards.

combos.description:

Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Verdant Catacombs.
Your life total is 2 or higher.

Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Eyeless Watcher.
When Eyeless Watcher enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating six 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate three Eldrazi Scions by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

Declare Lord Xander as an attacker, triggering its second ability, causing the defending player to mill half their library, rounded up.
Activate Consuming Aberration by tapping it, causing the opponent to mill cards equal to the cards in opponents' graveyards, milling the remainder of their library.

Cast Sensei's Divining Top either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Alela triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Faerie, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Repeat.

Cast Hulking Metamorph for its prototype cost by paying {2}{U}{U}. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Hulking Metamorph into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Hulking Metamorph dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Wormfang Newt, gaining its abilities.
When Hulking Metamorph enters, its first ability triggers, exiling it.
When Hulking Metamorph leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Hulking Metamorph from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Repeat from step 2.

results: Infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control
combos.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, targeting itself, but putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: Triskelion has a +1/+1 counter on it.

combos.description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
Volcano Hellion enters the battlefield, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to Brash Taunter and you.
You do not lose the game due to having zero or less life due to Platinum Angel.
Brash Taunter triggers, dealing an arbitarily large amount of damage to target opponent.

results: Infinite mana creatures you control can produce
combos.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ornithopter, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Ornithopter from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Ornithopter from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Ornithopter enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

Play Oboro, Palace in the Clouds.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, Mole Man and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
In response, activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning Oboro from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Mole Man trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Oboro, Palace in the Clouds from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, it and Mole Man trigger.
Repeat from step 3.

Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it, Mole Man, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Mole Man trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Mole Man trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

Cast Momentary Blink by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Shipwreck Dowser and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Shipwreck Dowser trigger.
Resolve the Shipwreck Dowser trigger, returning Momentary Blink from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Momentary Blink.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Shipwreck Dowser and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
When Ashcloud Phoenix dies, its first ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down.
When Ashcloud Phoenix enters the battlefield face-down, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
Yarus' second ability triggers, returning Ashcloud Phoenix from your graveyard to the battlefield face down, and then turning it face up.
Blasting Station and Ashcloud Phoenix's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Ashcloud Phoenix trigger, dealing 2 damage to each player.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Extraction Specialist.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Extraction Specialist, adding one mana of any color.
When Extraction Specialist dies, Saffi triggers, returning Extraction Specialist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Extraction Specialist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Bloom Tender and Slimefoot and Squee, adding two mana of any color(s).
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning Slimefoot and Squee and Bloom Tender to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

Activate Door to Nothingness by paying {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G} and tapping it, targeting yourself.
Holding priority, cast Radiant Performer by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Radiant Performer enters the battlefield, copying Door to Nothingness' ability for each opponent.
Resolve each copy of Door to Nothingness' ability, causing each opponent to lose the game.

Activate Hateflayer by tapping it, adding {R} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Hateflayer by paying {R} and untapping it, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Repeat.

Cast Transcendence by paying {3}{W}{W}{W}.
Transcendence triggers due to you having 20 or more life. However, you cannot lose the game due to Herald of Eternal Dawn.
Step 2 repeats in an infinite loop, causing the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.
combos.prerequisites: Your life total is 20 or higher.

results: Infinite mana lands you control can produce
Infinite untap of lands you control
combos.description:
Activate Itlimoc by tapping it, adding at least nine {G}.
Activate Silvanus's Invoker by paying {8}, causing Itlimoc to become a 8/8 Elemental with haste, and untapping Itlimoc.
Repeat.

results: Infinite combat damage to one opponent
Infinite mana lands you control can produce
Infinite untap of lands you control
combos.description:
Declare Palinchron and Moon-Circuit Hacker as attackers.
When they aren't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Thousand-Faced Shadow's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{U} and returning Moon-Circuit Hacker from the battlefield to your hand, putting Thousand-Faced Shadow onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Thousand-Faced Shadow enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a token copy of Palinchron that is tapped and attacking.
When the Palinchron token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Moon-Circuit Hacker's ninjutsu ability by paying {U} and returning Thousand-Faced Shadow from the battlefield to your hand, putting Moon-Circuit Hacker onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
Deal combat damage using the Palinchron tokens, dealing infinite combat damage to the defending opponent.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana.

Fetch a land using Evolving Wilds.
When the fetched land enters, Greensleeves and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Greensleeves trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Greensleeves from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Greensleeves triggers.
Repeat from step 5.
combos.prerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Evolving Wilds.

results: Infinitely large creatures you control until end of turn
combos.description:
Activate Goblin Sledder by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Metallic Mimic.
Resolve the Goblin Sledder ability.
Repeat.

Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Revolutionist and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Revolutionist tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Saw in Half and Burnt Offering from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Burnt Offering by paying {B} and sacrificing a Revolutionist token, adding {B}{B} plus an additional amount of {B} and/or {R} equal to its mana value minus 2. 
Repeat.

results: Prevent all damage that would be dealt to you
combos.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: You control another land.

results: Put all lands with a basic land type from your library onto the battlefield tapped
combos.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Lotus Cobra and Emeria Angel trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Emeria Angel trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

Activate Vizkopa Guildmage by paying {1}{W}{B}, causing each opponent to lose life whenever you gain life this turn.
Activate Wall of Blood by paying 1 life, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat step 2 until you have one life.
Cast Oketra's Last Mercy by paying {1}{W}{W}, causing your life total to become forty.
Vizkopa Guildmage triggers, causing each opponent to lose thirty-nine life.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing Greedy Freebooter and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Greedy Freebooter dies, it triggers, causing you to scry 1 and create a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Shambling Ghast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing Shambling Ghast and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

Activate Rograkh by sacrificing it.
Rograkh dies, triggering Koll, returning Rograkh from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Rograkh ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Activate Mortarpod's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Rograkh.
Repeat.

Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat each turn.

Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Mayhem Devil triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Sakashima of a Thousand Faces and Sakashima the Impostor each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
combos.prerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.

combos.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
HYDRA Assault Robot triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent.
Malcolm triggers, as HYDRA Assault Robot is a Pirate due to Maskwood Nexus, creating a Treasure token
When the Treasure enters, HYDRA Assault Robot triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent.
Repeat from step 3.
combos.prerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.

combos.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Zack Fair.
When Zack Fair dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it, Sapling Nursery, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sapling Nursery trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Sapling Nursery trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

Cast a copy of Brainstorm from exile by paying one mana, unpreparing Harmonized Trio.
Displacer Kitten and Storm-Kiln Artist both trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten ability, flickering Biblioplex Tomekeeper.
Biblioplex Tomekeeper triggers when it enters, preparing Harmonized Trio.
Resolve the remaining trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
When Crimson Kobolds enters the battlefield, Sai of the Shinobi triggers, attaching Sai of the Shinobi to Crimson Kobolds.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds.
When Crimson Kobolds dies, Koll triggers, returning Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

Activate Myr Turbine's first ability by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
The Myr enters the battlefield, triggering Grinding Station, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Myr and Grinding Station, untapping Myr Turbine.
Repeat.

results: Infinite untap of Myr you control
combos.description:
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Alloy Myr by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Myr Galvanizer.
Activate Myr Galvanizer by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping each other Myr you control.
Repeat.

At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers, casting a copy of Alrund's Epiphany without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Alrund's Epiphany, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

Draw a card during an opponent's turn.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters the battlefield, Sage of the Falls triggers, causing you to loot.
Repeat from step 2.

results: Infinite mana creatures you control can produce
combos.description:
Activate mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}.
Cast Aethersnipe for its evoke cost by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Aethersnipe enters the battlefield, both of its abilities trigger and Intruder Alarm triggers; put the evoke trigger on the stack first.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve Aethersnipe's first ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve Aethersnipe's evoke trigger, failing to sacrifice it since it is not on the battlefield.
Repeat.

Cast Abdel Adrian either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel until Abedl Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Cast Acrobatic Maneuver by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Wispweaver Angel to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Abdel Adrian and Wispweaver Angel's enter abilities.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Wispweaver Angel until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Wispweaver Angel trigger, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 4.
combos.manaNeeded: {6}{W}{W} plus enough mana to pay commander tax, if applicable

combos.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kin-Tree Warden, adding {C}{C}.
When Kin-Tree Warden dies, Yedora triggers, returning Kin-Tree Warden from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Kin-Tree Warden by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Kin-Tree Warden's morph ability by paying {G}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

Fetch a land using Bloodstained Mire.
When the fetched land enters, Tireless Provisioner and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Tireless Provisioner trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Tireless Provisioner triggers.
Repeat from step 5.
combos.prerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bloodstained Mire.
Your life total is at least 2.

combos.description:
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa's ability to sacrifice a creature and create at least 1 zombie.
Thornbite Staff allows Ghoulcaller Gisa to untap with her ability.
Sacrifice the zombie to Ghoulcaller Gisa again to create 3 zombies.
Thornbite Staff untaps Ghoulcaller Gisa again.
Sacrifice a zombie to Phyrexian Altar to add {B} to your mana pool.
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa's ability to sacrifice a zombie and create 3 zombies.
Thornbite Staff untaps Ghoulcaller Gisa again.
Repeat.

results: Win the game at the beginning of your next upkeep
combos.description:
Deal combat damage using Ant-Man, triggering its ability, creating a number of Treasure tokens.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, creating a copy of the artifact it's attached to and causing you to win the game.
combos.prerequisites: Ant-Man's power is at least 8 minus the number of Treasures you control, minus an additional 1 if Mechanized Production is attached to a Treasure.

combos.description:
Activate Horseshoe Crab by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Horseshoe Crab by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: Horseshoe Crab doesn't have summoning sickness.

combos.description:
Cast Time Warp from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Hades and causing it to re-enter the battlefield as Emet-Selch.
When Emet-Selch enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your upkeep during your extra turn, Emet-Selch triggers, transforming itself into Hades.
Repeat.

results: Put all lands from your library onto the battlefield tapped
combos.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodghast.
When Bloodghast dies, Wight of the Reliquary triggers, untapping Wight of the Reliquary.
Resolve the Wight of the Reliquary ability from step 1, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Cast Feign Death by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Feign Death, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Feign Death.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a persist creature that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Long Feng trigger.
Resolve the Long Feng trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other persist creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: One of the persist creatures does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.

combos.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary. When it enters, Tiller Engine, Selesnya Sanctuary and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Selesnya Sanctuary.
Holding priority, activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad of the Ilysian Grove.
Because of the additional Dryad of the Ilysian Grove token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn

combos.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nontoken green Insect.
When the Insect dies, Zask and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Zask trigger, putting the Insect on the bottom of your library from your graveyard and causing you to mill two cards.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for that Insect and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

results: Infinite untap of permanents you control
Infinite mana permanents you control can produce
combos.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sanctum Weaver.
Repeat.

Activate Mairsil using Tree of Perdition's ability by tapping it, exchanging target opponent's life total with Mairsil's toughness.
Activate Mairsil using Spikeshot Elder's ability by paying {1}{R}{R}, dealing damage equal to Mairsil's power to the opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

Activate the Sliver that can be cast using {B}{B} by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
The Sliver is put onto the top of your library instead of into your graveyard due to the replacement effect given to it by Pulmonic Sliver.
Cast the Sliver from the top of your library by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

Activate Myr Turbine by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
When the Myr enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Myr.
When the Myr dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Myr Turbine.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat.

Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Angel of Indemnity.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Angel of Indemnity.
When Angel of Indemnity enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times.
Resolve all abilities from step 3, milling any number of players any number of cards.

Cast Gray Merchant either from your hand by paying {3}{B}{B} or from the top of your library by paying 5 life.
When Gray Merchant enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Gray Merchant.
When Gray Merchant dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Gray Merchant from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: Your life total is at least 6 if Gray Merchant is on the top of your library, or you have {3}{B}{B} available otherwise.

combos.description:
Cast any other instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Fork by paying its mana cost, targeting the instant or sorcery cast in step 1.
Fork's storm ability triggers, creating at least one copy of Fork targeting the original Fork.
Resolve a copy of Fork, copying Fork targeting the original Fork.
Repeat step 4.

results: Infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control
combos.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and command tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Yannik and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Yannik leaves the battlefield, Felidar Guardian returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and re-enters the battlefield, causing Yannik to return from exile to the battlefield, and triggering both Yannik and Abdel Adrian's abilities.
Resolve the Yannik trigger, exiling Felidar Guardian until Yannik leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Yannik and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat from step 3.
combos.manaNeeded: {4}{W} plus enough mana to pay for command tax, if applicable

combos.description:
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep enters the battlefield, Sai of the Shinobi triggers, attaching Sai of the Shinobi to Kobolds of Kher Keep.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Koll triggers, returning Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
When Crookshank Kobolds enters the battlefield, Sai of the Shinobi triggers, attaching Sai of the Shinobi to Crookshank Kobolds.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds.
When Crookshank Kobolds dies, Koll triggers, returning Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

Create a token copy of Zealous Conscripts.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a token copy of the Zealous Conscripts copy.
When the Zealous Conscripts token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Ghired.
Repeat from step 2.

Tap Kilo by any method.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3}, untapping Kilo.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.

There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Misty Rainforest.
Your life total is 2 or higher.

combos.description:
Play Gruul Turf.
Kodama of the East Tree, Spark Double, and Gruul Turf trigger.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Gruul Turf onto the battlefield.
Spark Double and Gruul Turf trigger.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Spark Double token's trigger, putting Gruul Turf onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Gruul Turf trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
Timestream Navigator enters the battlefield, triggering Inalla; pay {1} to make a token copy of Timestream Navigator with haste.
Activate the token Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it, and putting it on the bottom of your library, taking an extra turn after this one.
Activate Crystal Shard by paying {U} and tapping it, returning the original Timestream Navigator to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

Activate Spawnsire of Ulamog's first ability by paying {4}, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawns die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to Urban Daggertooth.
Urban Daggertooth triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and Triskelion.
Repeat.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Moonshadow.
When Moonshadow dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Harnfel by discarding a card, exiling the top two cards of your library and allowing you to cast them this turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat.

Cast Suspension Field by paying {1}{W}.
When Suspension Field enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Suspension Field leaves the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Oblivion Ring to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Oblivion Ring enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Suspension Field.
When Suspension Field leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Oblivion Ring and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating at least one 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Oblivion Ring leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Suspension Field to the battlefield from exile.
Repeat from step 2.

Cast Sylvan Awakening for {2}{G}, causing all lands you control to become 2/2 creatures with reach, indestructible, and haste in addition to their other types until your next turn.
Activate an untapped land you control by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat step 2 until you control fifteen tapped creatures.
Activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping fifteen creatures you control, causing you to win the game.

Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Rocksteady triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat

Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Volcano Hellion enters, it triggers, dealing an arbitarily large amount of damage to you and a creature. The damage that would be dealt to you is dealt to Screaming Nemesis instead due to Pariah.
Screaming Nemesis triggers, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to an applicable target.

Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Volcano Hellion enters, it triggers, dealing an arbitarily large amount of damage to you and a creature. The damage that would be dealt to you is dealt to Donna Noble instead due to Pariah.
Donna Noble triggers, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to an applicable target.

Put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 3.
combos.prerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak

results: Infinite copies of nonland permanents you control
combos.description:
Cast Oko by paying {2}{G}{U}, causing it to enter the battlefield with six loyalty counters due to Vorinclex.
Cast Spark Double by paying {3}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a nonlegendary copy of Oko, and to enter the battlefield with eight loyalty counters due to Vorinclex.
Activate an Oko's third loyalty ability by removing five loyalty counters from it, causing you to create two token copies of each other nonland permanent you control.
If you created any legenedary tokens this way, put all but one of them into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 3 using a different Oko.
Once you have infinite Oko tokens, you may instead activate Oko's other abilities.

Cast the creature in your hand by paying one mana, causing the creature to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature, adding one mana.
When the creature dies, Host of the Hereafter triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Bastion of Remembrance triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Bastion of Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

Cast the self-suspending card by paying its mana cost if its in your hand, or any other spell otherwise if you have not cast a spell this turn.
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying its mana cost.
Taigam triggers, copying Nexus of Fate and then exiling it with four time counters on it and giving it suspend.
Resolve the copy of Nexus of Fate, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of that turn's upkeep, Nexus of Fate and the self-suspending card's suspend abilities trigger, removing a time counter from each of them.
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing three time counters from Nexus of Fate and the self-suspending card, triggering their suspend abilities.
Resolve the self-suspending card's suspend trigger, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost, and eventually exile it with time counters on it.
Resolve the Nexus of Fate's suspend trigger, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 3.
combos.prerequisites: You have a storm count of 1 if the self-suspending card is not in your hand, or a storm count of 0 otherwise.

combos.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber. When it enters untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel, Simic Growth Chamber and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Wayward Swordtooth.
Because of the additional Wayward Swordtooth token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn

combos.description:
Activate Myr Turbine's first ability by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
The Myr enters the battlefield, triggering Blasting Station, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Myr and Blasting Station, untapping Myr Turbine.
Repeat.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another Angel.
When the Angel dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token.
When the Angel enters, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat.

Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Al Bhed Salvagers, Sifter of Skulls and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls ability, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.

combos.description:
Activate Tree of Tales by tapping it, creating a Food and a Treasure artifact token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Food and Treasure, untapping Tree of Tales.
Repeat.

Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, blinking Karmic Guide.
Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, triggering itself, Preston and Blasting Station.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning any creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Karmic Guide, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Preston trigger from step 2, creating a token copy of Karmic Guide that is a 0/1 white Illusion.
The Karmic Guide token enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Blasting Station.
Resolve the Karmic Guide token's trigger, returning the nontoken Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

All creatures your opponent control lose flying.
Moat prevents things without flying from attacking.
Creatures your opponent can not fulfill the conditions necessary to attack.

Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 3.

Gain life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.
combos.prerequisites: You have a way to gain life.

combos.description:
Activate Arbor Elf by tapping it, untapping the enchanted forest.
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {U}{G}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Arbor Elf.
Repeat.

results: Exile your library with the ability to play the exiled cards until end of turn
combos.description:
Activate Putrid Imp by discarding a card.
Containment Construct triggers, exiling the discarded card with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Sheoldred triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Putrid Imp ability.
Repeat.

Cast Astrid by paying {1}{W}.
When Astrid enters the battlefield, its first ability and Samwise Gamgee trigger.
Resolve the Astrid trigger, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Samwise Gamgee trigger, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Astrid, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Samwise Gamgee by sacrificing three Foods, returning Astrid from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

results: Infinite untap of permanents you control
Infinite mana permanents you control can produce
combos.description:
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{U}.
Activate Derevi by paying {1}{G}{W}{U}, putting it onto the battlefield from the command zone.
Put Derevi into your graveyard due to the legend rule, and then choose to return Derevi to the command zone.
Derevi's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers twice due to Panharmonicon.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Bloom Tender.
Holding priority, activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{U}.
Resolve the second Derevi trigger, untapping Bloom Tender.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: You control a copy or clone of Derevi that is legendary and has Derevi's name.

combos.description:
Activate Workhorse by removing four +1/+1 counters, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Workhorse, adding {C}{C}.
Workhorse dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Workhorse from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Workhorse enters the battlefield with four +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

Deal combat damage to an opponent with Raving Dead.
Raving Dead triggers, causing the opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Blitzwing triggers, causing the opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Priest of Urabrask, adding {C}{C}.
Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Priest of Urabrask from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, adding {R}{R}{R}.
 Repeat.

Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Popular Egotist and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.

combos.description:
Fetch a land using Windswept Heath.
When the fetched land enters, Zendikar's Roil and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Zendikar's Roil trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Zendikar's Roil triggers.
Repeat from step 5.
combos.prerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Windswept Heath.
Your life total is 2 or higher.

combos.description:
Deal damage to Coalhauler Swine.
Coalhauler Swine triggers, dealing that much damage to each player. Any damage that would be dealt to you is instead dealt to Coalhauler Swine due to With Great Power....
Repeat step 2.

Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Skyshroud Ranger.
Activate the land and another land by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning a land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping another land.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites:
You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
You control a mana-producing land.

combos.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers if it didn't have a -1/-1 counter, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if Lesser Masticore didn't have flying.
Resolve the persist trigger, if applicable, returning Lesser Masticore from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning Lesser Masticore from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if Lesser Masticore is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

results: Infinite mana lands you control can produce
Infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control
combos.description:
Activate up to two lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Experiment Kraj by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Horseshoe Crab.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Horseshoe Crab's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Activate Experiment Kraj by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Argothian Elder.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Horseshoe Crab's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Argothian Elder's ability by tapping it, untapping up to two lands.
Activate up to two lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 5.

Equip Rograkh with Grafted Wargear.
Sacrifice Rograkh to Goblin Bombardment to deal 1 damage to any target.
Koll triggers, returning Rograkh to you hand.
Cast Rograkh.
Repeat.

Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, dealing 1 damage to any opponent.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

Cast The Great Henge by paying {G}{G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Teferi.
Activate The Great Henge by tapping it, adding {G}{G} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Teferi's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, returning The Great Henge from the battlefield to your hand and drawing a card.
Repeat.

Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield, Good-Fortune Unicorn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Saproling.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Saproling token, untapping a basic land.
Repeat.

results: Infinite mana lands you control can produce
combos.description:
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}.
Activate Trench Behemoth twice by returning two lands from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting both lands from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the lands.
Repeat.

Cast Storm Herd by paying {8}{W}{W}, creating a number of 1/1 Pegasus creature tokens equal to your life total.
When the Pegasi enter, Warstorm Surge triggers that many times, dealing that much damage divided among any number of target(s)

results: You control one opponent on each of their turns
combos.description:
Activate Mindslaver by paying {4}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to gain control of target opponent during their next turn.
During your next turn, activate Tameshi by paying {6}{W} and returning a land you control to your hand, returning Mindslaver from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Play any land card from your hand.
Repeat.
combos.manaNeeded: {4} available the first turn, with {10}{W} each other turn

results: You do not draw cards during your draw steps
combos.description:
At the beginning of your draw step, Island Sanctuary causes you to skip your card draw, and prevent creatures without flying and/or islandwalk from attacking you.
Because Archetype of Imagination causes all creatures to lose flying, only creatures with islandwalk can attack you.

Activate Horseshoe Crab by tapping it, adding {U}.
Badgermole Cub triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Horseshoe Crab by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: Horseshoe Crab doesn't have summoning sickness.

results: Infinite casts of a specific spell
combos.description:
Cast All Aboard using the convoke ability from Party Thrasher by tapping Skycoach Conductor.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Skycoach Conductor, which enters prepared.
Resolve All Aboard.
Repeat.

Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token due to Quina.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: You control another creature.

results: Infinite combat damage to one opponent
Infinite mana lands you control can produce
Infinite untap of lands you control
combos.description:
Declare Palinchron and Ingenious Infiltrator as attackers.
When they aren't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}{U}{B}.
Activate Thousand-Faced Shadow's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{U} and returning Ingenious Infiltrator from the battlefield to your hand, putting Thousand-Faced Shadow onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Thousand-Faced Shadow enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a token copy of Palinchron that is tapped and attacking.
When the Palinchron token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Ingenious Infiltrator's ninjutsu ability by paying {U}{B} and returning Thousand-Faced Shadow from the battlefield to your hand, putting Ingenious Infiltrator onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
Deal combat damage using the Palinchron tokens, dealing infinite combat damage to the defending opponent.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}{U}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

results: Infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control
Win the game at the beginning of your next upkeep
combos.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

Cast Shrieking Drake by paying one mana.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Oboro, Palace in the Clouds from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, Nissa triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's second ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, triggering itself, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

results: Infinite casts of any instants and/or sorcery cards in your hand or graveyard
Infinite mana lands you control can produce
combos.description:
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Archaeomancer and Cloud of Faeries.
When Archaeomancer and Cloud of Faeries enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger twice each.
Resolve the first Archaeomancer trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second Archaeomancer trigger, returning any other instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the first Cloud of Faeries trigger, untapping up to two lands.
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Resolve the second Cloud of Faeries trigger, untapping up to two lands.
Repeat.

Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Muldrotha.
Kaya's Ghostform and Pitiless Plunderer triggers.
Resolve the Kaya's Ghostform's trigger, returning Muldrotha to the battlefield.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer's trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia's ability, causing target player to mill six cards.
Activate Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard by paying {B}, targeting Muldrotha.
Repeat.

Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, it triggers.
Activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve Selesnya Sanctuary's triggered ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

Pay {7} twice, create 2 copies of Powerstone Shard, leaving {3}.
Tap 2 of the token Powerstone Shards for {6}.
Pay {7}, leaving {2}, to create another token copy of Powerstone Shard.
Tap the 2 remaining untapped Powerstone Shards for {8}.
Pay {7} to create a token copy of Powerstone Shard, tapping it for {5}, leaving you with {8}.
Pay {7} to create a token copy of Powerstone Shard, tapping it for {6}, leaving you with {7}.
Pay {7} to create a token copy of Powerstone Shard, tapping it for {7}, leaving you with {7}.
At This point, each Powerstone Shard will tap for more mana than it costs, allowing you to generate infinite {C}.
Pay infinite {C} to create infinite copies of Cogwork Assembler.

Activate The Book of Exalted Deeds by paying {W}{W}{W}, tapping and exiling it, putting an enlightened counter on an Angel you control.
Cast Transcendence by paying {3}{W}{W}{W}.
Transcendence triggers due to you having 20 or more life. However, you cannot lose the game due to the Angel with the enlightened counter on it.
Step 3 repeats in an infinite loop, causing the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.
combos.prerequisites: Your life total is 20 or higher.

combos.description:
Activate Doom Whisperer by exiling the top two cards of your library due to Ashiok, causing you to surveil 2.
Repeat.

Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Drafna by paying {1}{U}, returning Mana Vault from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Mana Vault by paying {1}.
Repeat.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another artifact creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: You control another artifact creature.

combos.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting the Eldrazi.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the Eldrazi.
Lightning Greaves's ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the Eldrazi from exile by paying {0} due to Eye of Ugin.
Repeat.

results: Destroy all permanents opponents control each turn
combos.description:
Cast Spine of Ish Sah by paying {0} due to Sami.
When Spine of Ish Sah enters, its first ability and Grinding Station trigger, with Spine of Ish Sah targeting either a permanent an opponent controls or itself if an opponent doesn't control a targetable permanent.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Spine of Ish Sah.
If you targeted Spine of Ish Sah in step 2, the ability will fizzle due to having no legal target.
Spine of Ish Sah's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 4.
Resolve the Spine of Ish Sah trigger from step 2, if applicable.
Repeat from step 1.

results: Infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control
combos.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.
combos.prerequisites: You have a way to gain life.

results: Near-infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control
combos.description:
Activate Lonis by paying {2} and sacrificing another artifact.
If the artifact was a Clue, Lonis' third ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on any other creature you control.
Resolve the Lonis ability, putting two +1/+1 counters on it and causing you to draw a card.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating two Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Clue, adding {C}{C}.
Lonis' third ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on any other creature you control.
Repeat.

Resolve the copy of the Spawn-Gang Commander spell.
Resolve the copy of Spawn-Gang Commander's trigger, creating three 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.

Resolve the copy of Ulalek's trigger from step 4, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy the Spawn-Gang Commander spell, Ulalek's trigger and Spawn-Gang Commander's trigger.

Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.

combos.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, getting an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Mnemonic Wall.
Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Cast Ad Nauseam by paying {3}{B}{B}.
Resolve Ad Nauseam, revealing the top card of your library, putting that card into your hand and losing life equal to that card's mana value.
Repeat the process in step 2 as many times as desired.

Cast Dramatic Reversal by paying {1}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Izzet Guildmage's first ability by paying {2}{U}, copying Dramatic Reversal.
Resolve the Dramatic Reversal copy, untapping all nonland permanents you control.
Activate all nonland permanents by tapping those, adding at least {3}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.

combos.description:
Activate the land with Wild Growth attached by tapping it, adding {1}.
Wild Growth triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Silvanus's Invoker by paying {1}, untapping Gruul Turf and causing it to become an 8/8 Elemental with trample and haste in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat.

Cast Unearth by paying {B}, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.

Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Unearth, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Unearth copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.

Activate up to three lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Frantic Search for its escape cost by paying {2}{U} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to loot twice and untap three lands.
Mesmeric Orb triggers three times, causing you to mill three cards.
Repeat.

Activate Tree of Perdition by tapping it, targeting your opponent and setting their life total to 13.
Cast Blasphemous Act, dealing 13 damage to Stuffy Doll.
Stuffy Doll triggers, dealing 13 damage to your opponent.

At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Eternal Witness.
Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat, Zahur and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Zahur ability, creating a tapped 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 once.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 5, causing a player to mill three cards
Repeat from step 5.

Put Undercover Operative into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Undercover Operative dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Astral Dragon, gaining its abilities.

Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 5.

Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, targeting Palinchron.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a token copy of Palinchron.
The Palinchron token enters the battlefield, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve Clockspinning, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you can target any permanents you control in step 2 to create infinite token copies of them.

results: Infinite untap of Myr you control
combos.description:
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Cursed Mirror by paying {2}{R}, having it enter the battlefield as a copy of Myr Galvanizer with haste.
Activate Myr Galvanizer by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping each other Myr you control.
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Cursed Mirror by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping each other Myr you control.
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding {C}{C}
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Sephiroth triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Reassembling Skeleton enters, Carnival of Souls triggers, adding {B} and causing you to lose 1 life.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: You either have Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER on the battlefield or have the emblem granted by Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel.

combos.description:
Fetch a land using Arid Mesa.
When the fetched land enters, Springheart Nantuko and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Repeat from step 5.
combos.prerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Arid Mesa.
Your life total is at least 2.

combos.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
When Crimson Kobolds enters the battlefield, Lathliss and Cloudstone Curio triggers.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Crimson Kobolds from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding at least {G/U}{G/U}{G/U}.
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling the counters on target permanent.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: Gilder Bairn is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.

combos.description:
Cast Stitch Together by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Stitch Together.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, causing a player to mill card(s).
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Stitch Together
Resolve the Stitch Together copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
combos.prerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.

combos.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping two creatures you control, copying the Helm of the Host trigger.
Resolve the copy of the Helm of the Host trigger, creating two token copies of Kirol that aren't legendary.
Holding priority, activate the Kirol token by tapping two creatures you control, copying the Helm of the Host trigger.
Repeat from step 3.

Cast Felidar Guardian by paying its mana cost.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Karmic Guide
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

Cast Tree of Perdition by paying {3}{B}.
When Tree of Perdition enters the battlefield, Jaws of Defeat triggers, targeting an opponent.
If the opponent has 13 or more life, hold priority and then activate Tree of Perdition by tapping it, swapping its toughness with an opponent's life total.
Resolve the Jaws of Defeat trigger, causing the opponent targeted in step 3 to lose life equal to Tree of Perdition's toughness.
The opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having 0 or less life.

Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {2}, returning Chromatic Orrery from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Chromatic Orrery by paying at most {3}.
Repeat.

results: Infinite recursion of Knights you control
combos.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing each Knight you control, adding {W/B} for each Knight.
When you sacrifice Cavalier of Dawn, its second ability triggers, returning Knights' Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Knights' Charge by paying {1}{W}{B}.
Activate Knights' Charge by paying {6}{W}{B} and sacrificing it, returning all Knights from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
combos.manaNeeded: {7}{W}{W}{B}{B} minus {W/B} for each nontoken Knight you control

combos.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Fiend Hunter.
When the Fiend Hunter token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Fiend Hunter token, adding one mana of any color.
When the Fiend Hunter token dies, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Cast Seething Song by paying {2}{R}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping it, adding {U} or {R}.
Activate Nivix Guildmage's second ability by paying {2}{U}{R}, copying Seething Song.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the copy of Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Priest of Gix, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Soldevi Digger by paying {2}, putting Priest of Gix on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Priest of Gix into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

results: Infinite copies of permanent spells you control
combos.description:
Cast Huatli's Raptor by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Huatli's Raptor spell three times.
Resolve the first Huatli's Raptor spell.
When the Huatli's Raptor token enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a persist creature that does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Bhaal trigger.
Resolve the Bhaal trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the remaining persist creature.
Resolve the sacrificed creature's persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1.
Repeat.

results: Put all lands from your hand and library onto the battlefield

Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning the basic land from the battlefield to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing the Illusion, causing you to draw a card and put the basic land from your hand onto the battlefield tapped, and then repeat this process once if you control eight or more lands, putting any other land from your hand onto the battlefield instead.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm and Amulet of Vigor triggers.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone and Dina.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping the basic land.
Repeat.

Activate Sliver Queen by paying {1}, creating a 1/1 Sliver creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Sliver token, adding {1}.
Repeat.
