combos.description:
Activate Myr Welder using The Eternity Elevator's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
If Voltaic Construct is on the battlefield, activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Myr Welder. Otherwise, activate Myr Welder using Voltaic Construct's ability by paying {2}, untapping Myr Welder.
Repeat.

Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Volcano Hellion enters, it triggers, dealing an arbitarily large amount of damage to you and a creature. The damage that would be dealt to you is dealt to Donna Noble instead due to Pariah's Shield.
Donna Noble triggers, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to an applicable target.

During your end step, activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ugin's Nexus.
Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Esoteric Duplicator triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Ugin's Nexus at the beginning of your next end step.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability, causing target player to mill three cards.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your end step, Esoteric Duplicator triggers, creating a token copy of Ugin's Nexus.
Repeat.

Activate War Elemental using Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
War Elemental triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat.

Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, getting an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Mnemonic Wall.
Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Infinite untap of permanents you control
Infinite mana permanents you control can produce
combos.description:

Cast Cackling Counterpart by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Kairi.
Put the Kairi token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Kairi token dies, it triggers, causing you to mill six cards and return High Tide and Cackling Counterpart from your graveyard to your hand.

Activate at least three Islands by tapping them, adding {U}{U}{U}.
High Tide triggers twice for each Island tapped this way, adding that much {U}.

Cast Cackling Counterpart by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Kairi.
Put the Kairi token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Kairi token dies, it triggers, causing you to mill six cards and return Turnabout and Cackling Counterpart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 6.

Repeat.

combos.description:

Resolve Vitalize, untapping all creatures you control

Repeat.

Cast Infested Thrinax by paying {3}{B}{G}.
When Infested Thrinax enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Saproling creature tokens when a nontoken creature you control dies.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Hogaak.

Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by tapping seven Saprolings.
Repeat from step 3.

combos.description:

Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Simic Growth Chamber.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Repeat any number of times.

Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Warp from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Warp during your draw step.
Repeat.

Equip Kobolds of Kher Keep with Grafted Wargear.
Sacrifice Kobolds of Kher Keep to Goblin Bombardment to deal 1 damage to any target.
Koll triggers, returning Kobolds of Kher Keep to you hand.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep.
Repeat.

combos.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Mole Man and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Mole Man trigger, creating a 1/1 Minion creature token.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Wight of the Reliquary.
Repeat.

Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.

When Ardent Elementalist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.

Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Resolve Molten Duplication, creating a token copy of Cormela.
Put the tapped Cormela into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Cormela dies, it triggers, returning Molten Duplication from your graveyard to your hand.

Infinite mana lands you control can produce

Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.

When Eternal Witness and Cloud of Faeries enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger twice each.
Resolve the first Eternal Witness trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.

Resolve the first Cloud of Faeries trigger, untapping up to two lands.
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Resolve the second Cloud of Faeries trigger, untapping up to two lands.

At the beginning of your combat phase, Harried Dronesmith triggers, creating a creature token.

Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Pia and Kiran Nalaar, adding {C}{C}.
When Pia and Kiran Nalaar dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Pia and Kiran Nalaar from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Pia and Kiran Nalaar enters, it triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

Activate Neerdiv using Aphetto Alchemist's ability by tapping it.
Neerdiv triggers, causing a player to mill cards equal to its power.
Resolve the Neerdiv ability from step 1, untapping it.
Repeat.

Neerdiv has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Neerdiv, Devious Diver does not have summoning sickness.

Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the two tokens, untapping Transmutation Font.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Initiates of the Ebon Hand by paying {1}, adding {B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Repeat.

Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Open the Graves trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

When Branchsnap Lorian enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Evolutionary Leap ability, causing you to reveal a creature card from your library and put it into your hand.
Activate Branchsnap Lorian by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Activate Branchsnap Lorian's morph ability by paying {G}, turning it face-up.
Repeat.

Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Narset by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to look at the top four cards of your library, then reveal Sensei's Divining Top and put it into your hand.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Narset.
Repeat.

Azor enters the battlefield, preventing opponents from casting instants or sorceries during their next turn.
Repeat during each of your turns.

Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.

When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

Activate Stimulus Package by sacrificing a Treasure, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Citizen, adding one mana of any color.
The Citizen dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

Play Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it, Nesting Dragon, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it and Nesting Dragon trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.

Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.

Cast Final Fortune for {R}{R}.
Move to your extra turn.

With Archaeomancer's etb, put Final Fortune back into your hand.
Cast Final Fortune for {R}{R}.
Move to your end step, then activate Obeka to end your turn with Archaeomancer's sacrifice trigger and Final Fortune's lose the game trigger on the stack.
Repeat 2-6.

Repeat.

Cast Ozox by paying {2}{B}.

Activate Myr Galvanizer by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping each other Myr you control.

Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.

Overgrown Armasaur and Blazing Sunsteel trigger.
Resolve the Overgrown Armasaur trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Blazing Sunsteel trigger, dealing damage to Overgrown Armasaur.

Resolve the copy of Supernatural Stamina.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.

Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.

Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.

Kodama of the East Tree, Sakashima of a Thousand Faces, and Arid Archway trigger.

combos.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

results: Win the game at the beginning of your next upkeep
combos.description:
During the end step prior to your turn, activate Ethereal Champion by paying 1 life, preventing the next one damage dealt to it this turn.
Repeat until you have one life.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites:
You control an additional Zombie.
You control another Zombie.

combos.description:
Cast Icewind Stalwart by paying its mana cost.
When Icewind Stalwart enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Icewind Stalwart.
Resolve the Icewind Stalwart ability, blinking Karmic Guide
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Icewind Stalwart from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate either of the creatures by tapping it, targeting the other creature.
If the tapped creature was a Merfolk, Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the ability from step 1, untapping the targeted creature.
Repeat.

Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Workhorse with haste, that enters the battlefield with four +1/+1 counters.
Activate Workhorse four times by removing four +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Workhorse dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Kiki-Jiki triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

results: Infinite charge counters on a permanent
combos.description:
Cast Tormod's Crypt by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Play a land.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Mutable Explorer.
When the Mutable Explorer token enters, it triggers, creating a Mutavault land token that enters tapped.
When the Mutavault token enters, Springheart Nantuko, Amulet of Vigor and Tireless Provisioner trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping the Mutavault token.
Holding priority, activate the Mutavault token by tapping it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Mutable Explorer.
Repeat from step 3.
combos.prerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.

combos.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Walking Ballista, adding {C}{C}.
When Walking Ballista dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Walking Ballista from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
Deathgreeter triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying 2 life.
Gravecrawler enters the battlefield, triggering Ayara, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

results: Infinite mana permanents you control can produce
Return all instant and sorcery cards from your graveyard to your hand
combos.description:
Cast Doppelgang by paying {15}{G}{U}, creating five token copies of Mnemonic Wall and of the four mana-producing permanents.
When the Mnemonic Wall tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Doppelgang and up to four other instant or sorcery cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate seventeen of the mana-producing permanent tokens by tapping them, adding at least {15}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tokens and mana, you may instead target any other permanents using Doppelgang.

Cast Polyraptor by paying {6}{G}{G}.
When Polyraptor enters the battlefield, Pandemonium triggers, dealing 5 damage to Polyraptor.
Polyraptor dies as a state-based action due to lethal damage.
Polyraptor triggers, creating a token copy of itself.
Repeat from step 2 using the new Polyraptor token instead.

Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Tomb Trawler by paying {2}, causing you to put Capture of Jingzhou on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Capture of Jingzhou from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.

results: Infinitely large creature until end of turn
combos.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Melira.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Archaeomancer.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Archaeomancer from exile to the battlefield.
When Archaeomancer enters, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting Midnight Guard.
Activate Midnight Guard by tapping it, returning the creature that costs no mana from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast that creature by paying {0}.
When that creature enters, Midnight Guard triggers, untapping Midnight Guard.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

results: Infinitely large creatures you control until end of turn
combos.description:
Activate Brigid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Brigid
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {1}, giving creatures you control all creature types and base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

Cast Restoration Angel by paying its mana cost.
When Restoration Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Restoration Angel.
Resolve the Restoration Angel ability, blinking Sister Hospitaller
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Restoration Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

results: Infinite mana lands you control can produce
Infinite copies of artifacts you control
Infinite copies of creatures you control with haste
Infinite untap of lands you control
combos.description:
Activate up to four lands except Minamo by tapping them, adding at least {U}{U}{R}.
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake with haste.
When the Peregrine Drake token enters, it triggers, untapping Minamo and up to four other lands.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Saheeli.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: You control up to four lands excluding Minamo that can tap to produce at least {U}{U}{R}.

results: Infinite mana lands you control can produce
Infinite untap of lands you control
combos.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Izzet Chronarch and Peregrine Drake
When Izzet Chronarch and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Chronarch trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.

results: Infinite recursion of creature cards with power 2 or less
combos.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Reveillark.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Reveillark.
When Reveillark leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian and up to one other creature with power 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate three Eldrazi Scions by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Patron of the Arts and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Patron of the Arts dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Cathodion from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Cathodion and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Cathodion dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Patron of the Arts from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Patron of the Arts enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

Declare Burakos as an attacker.
Burakos triggers, creating at least two Treasure tokens, two Clue tokens and two Food tokens, and causing the defending player to lose at least 2 life.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

Cast Phantom Steed by paying {3}{U}.
When Phantom Steed enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Lumbering Battlement to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Lumbering Battlement enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Phantom Steed until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield.
Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Abdel Adrian to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Lumbering Battlement and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating at least one 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Phantom Steed to return from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
Cast Abdel Adrian for its mana cost.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it exiles Phantom Steed until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Abdel Adrian's ETB.
When Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, Lumbering Battlement is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Lumbering Battlement enters, it exiles Abdel Adrian until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lumbering Battlement's ETB.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Phantom Steed is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Phantom Steed enters, it exiles Lumbering Battlement until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Phantom Steed's ETB.
When Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
combos.prerequisites: Lumbering Battlement must be exiled by Phantom Steed, and Abdel Adrian must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
combos.manaNeeded: {3}{U} and {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand

combos.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 1 until Deathbringer Thoctar has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Deathbringer Thoctar.
Deathbringer Thoctar dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

Cast Donate by paying {2}{U}, giving Nine Lives to an opponent.
Cast Cleansing Nova by paying {3}{W}{W}, destroying all artifacts and enchantments.
Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, causing its controller to lose the game.

Fetch a land using Fabled Passage.
When the fetched land enters, Toggo and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Toggo trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Toggo from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Toggo triggers.
Repeat from step 5.
combos.prerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Fabled Passage.

combos.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a persist creature that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Long Feng trigger.
Resolve the Long Feng trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other persist creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: One of the persist creatures does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.

combos.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Anax trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing another artifact, which is a Food due to Gourmand's Talent.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, putting a +1/+1 counter on Umbral Collar Zealot.
Repeat.

Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep enters the battlefield, Ronin Warclub triggers, attaching Ronin Warclub to Kobolds of Kher Keep.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Koll triggers, returning Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Ornithopter enters the battlefield, triggering Sai of the Shinobi, attaching Sai of the Shinobi to Ornithopter.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ornithopter, adding one mana of any color.
Ornithopter dies, triggering Koll, returning Ornithopter from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Activate Osgir by tapping it, paying {5}, and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating two token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put one of them into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The token copy of Ugin's Nexus that was just put into your graveyard triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Osgir by paying {1} and sacrificing a token copy of Ugin's Nexus.
The sacrificed token copy of Ugin's Nexus triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Osgir's ability resolves, giving target creature you control +2/+0 until end of turn.
Move to your next extra turn.
Activate Isochron Scepter by tapping it and paying {2}, copying Pull from Eternity.
Cast Pull from Eternity, returning Ugin's Nexus to your graveyard.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat.

Cast Astrid by paying {1}{W}.
When Astrid enters the battlefield, its first ability and Samwise Gamgee trigger.
Resolve the Astrid trigger, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Samwise Gamgee trigger, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Astrid, adding {W}.
Activate Samwise Gamgee by sacrificing three Foods, returning Astrid from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

Activate RMS Titanic's crew ability by tapping any number of creatures with power 3 or greater, causing it to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using RMS Titanic, triggering its ability, causing you to sacrifice it and create at least seven Treasure tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Treasures, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast RMS Titanic from your graveyard this turn.
Cast RMS Titanic from your graveyard by paying {3}{R}.
Repeat each turn.
combos.prerequisites:
Other creatures you control have power 3 or greater.
An opponent cannot block RMS Titanic.

combos.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Sun Titan.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Saffi triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

Activate Scuttletide by paying {1} and discarding a card, creating a 0/3 Crab creature token.
When the Crab enters the battlefield, Marneus triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Crab, adding {1}.
Repeat.

Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating six 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping four Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Wernog.
Wernog leaves and enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice, causing you to create at least two Clue and two Food artifact tokens.
Activate three of the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, choosing Black Lotus.
Cast the copy of Black Lotus.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing itself, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, exiling and returning Garth One-Eye onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

results: Prevent all damage that would be dealt to you
combos.description:
Whenever damage would be dealt to you, Pariah's Shield causes that damage to be redirected to the creature it is attached to.
Since Inviolability grants an ability to the creature preventing damage being dealt to it, no damage is dealt to you or to that creature.
combos.prerequisites: Inviolability and Pariah's Shield are attached to the same creature.

combos.description:
Activate Liliana's third loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, allowing you to cast Zombie spells from your graveyard this turn.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
Shambing Ghast dies, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Shambling Ghast enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat from step 2.

Cast Sakashima's Student by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Sakashima's Student into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Sakashima's Student dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Wormfang Turtle, gaining its abilities.
When Sakashima's Student enters, its first ability triggers, exiling it.
When Sakashima's Student leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Sakashima's Student from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {2}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing any other creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
Sadistic Glee triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature it is attached to.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

Tap Malcolm to deal 1 damage to target opponent, creating a treasure from Malcolm's trigger.
Sacrifice the treasure token for {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura to untap Malcolm.
Repeat.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion, adding {C}{C}
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodsoaked Champion enters, Carnival of Souls triggers, adding {B} and causing you to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

results: Infinite mana lands you control can produce
Infinite untap of nontoken creatures you control
Infinite mana nontoken creatures you control can produce
Infinite untap of lands you control
combos.description:
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping it and Circle of Dreams Druid.
Repeat.

Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Reito Lantern by paying {3}, causing you to put Temporal Manipulation on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Temporal Manipulation from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.

Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1.
Repeat.

Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Field of the Dead triggers, creating a 2/2 black Zombie creature token
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Field of the Dead triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: You control a land.

combos.description:
Activate Vizkopa Guildmage's second ability by paying {1}{W}{B}.
Activate Disciple of Griselbrand by paying {1} and sacrificing Serra Avatar, causing you to gain life equal to Serra Avatar's toughness.
Vizkopa Guildmage triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life you gained.

Cast Windfall by paying {2}{U}, causing each player to discard their hand and then draw a number of cards equal to the greatest number of cards a player discarded this way.
Kederekt Parasite triggers for each card drawn this way, giving each opponent a poison counter for each card they drew.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters
combos.prerequisites: You control a red permanent.

results: Infinite mana lands you control can produce
Infinite untap of lands you control
combos.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Lotus Field.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Voyaging Satyr.
Repeat.

Tap Druid for {G}.
Untap Druid using her own ability, adding -1/-1 to her.
Do this until she dies.
Mikaeus triggers, returning Druid with a +1/+1 counter.
Druid is summoning sick.
Tap a basic land floating mana.
Tap Druid with Earthcraft to untap the land.
Untap Druid with her own ability.
Do this until Druid dies.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Nether Traitor, adding {B}.
When Nether Traitor dies, Anax triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature token dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

results: Infinite mana lands you control can produce
Infinite untap of nontoken artifacts you control
Infinite mana nontoken artifacts you control can produce
Infinite untap of lands you control
combos.description:
Give the artifact type to Argothian Elder using Liquimetal Coating.
Activate Argothian Elder by tapping it, untapping it as it's a land due to Toph and another land you control.
Repeat step 2.

Cast Kodama of the East Tree either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{G}{G} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Holding priority, cast Double Major by paying {G}{U}, copying the Kodama of the East Tree spell, with the copy not being legendary.
Resolve both Kodama of the East Tree spells.
Play Izzet Boilerworks.
Both Kodama of the East Trees and Izzet Boilerworks trigger.
Resolve the token Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the nontoken Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
The token Kodama of the East Tree and Izzet Boilerworks trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the token Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
The nontoken Kodama of the East Tree and Izzet Boilerworks trigger.
Repeat from step 7.
combos.prerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.

combos.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host and Brudiclad trigger.
Resolve the Helm of the Host trigger, creating a token copy of Biovisionary with haste.

Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Skyshroud Ranger.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Storm Cauldron triggers, returning the land from your battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {4}{G}{G}{G}{W}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters the battlefield, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

Fetch a land using Terramorphic Expanse.
When the fetched land enters, Toggo and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Toggo trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Toggo from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Toggo triggers.
Repeat from step 5.
combos.prerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Terramorphic Expanse.

results: Infinite mana lands you control can produce
Put all land cards from your library and graveyard onto the battlefield
combos.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.

combos.description:
Cast Yawgmoth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Yawgmoth enters the battlefield, Elas il-Kor and Scurry Oak's evolve ability trigger.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Elas il-Kor trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Elas il-Kor and Scurry Oak's evolve ability trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
combos.prerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
Scurry Oak has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Your life total is at least 2.

combos.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Corpsejack Menace.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing another nontoken creature you control and Slimefoot and Squee, adding {1}{B}.
When the creatures die, Pawn of Ulamog triggers twice, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the two Eldrazi Spawns, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enter the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

Activate a land by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Living Twister's second ability by paying {G}, returning the land from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Llanowar Scout.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {G}.

results: Infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control
Win the game at the beginning of your next upkeep
combos.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

Play Simic Growth Chamber. When it enters untapped due to Archelos, Simic Growth Chamber and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Oracle of Mul Daya.
Because of the additional Oracle of Mul Daya token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn

combos.description:
Declare Satya as an attacker.
Satya triggers, creating four token copies of Ocelot Pride that are tapped and attacking and causing you to get {E}{E}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, the Ocelot Pride token gives you the city's blessing.
At the beginning of your end step, Satya triggers four times, and each Ocelot Pride you control triggers once.
Resolve the first Ocelot Pride trigger, causing you to create four 1/1 Cat creature tokens if you gained life this turn, and then causing you to create four token copies of each token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
Repeat step 4 for each remaining trigger.

results: Infinite mana lands you control can produce
combos.description:
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

Activate Mairsil using Endling's third ability by paying {B}, giving Mairsil undying until end of turn.
Activate Mairsil using Blood Vassal's ability by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
Mairsil dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Mairsil using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

Cast Masterful Replication by paying {5}{U}, causing each artifact you control to become a copy of Ugin's Nexus until end of turn.
Put the original Ugin's Nexus and all other artifacts you control except one into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take that many extra turns after this one.

Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Harmonized Trio by tapping it and two other creatures you control, causing it to become prepared.
Cast a copy of Brainstorm by paying {U}.
Talrand triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve Brainstorm, causing you to draw three cards and put two cards from your hand onto the top of your library.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites:
You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {U}.
You control two untapped creatures excluding the mana-producing creature and Harmonized Trio.

results: Infinite untap of creatures you control
Infinite mana creatures you control can produce
combos.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and General Kreat as attackers.
General Kreat triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, General Kreat triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

results: Prevent all damage that would be dealt to you
combos.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: You control another land.

combos.description:
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability, causing Gilded Lotus to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Cast Freed from the Real by paying {2}{U}, enchanting Gilded Lotus.
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, South Wind Avatar, Fumulus and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Fumulus ability, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, South Wind Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.

combos.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Susurian Voidborn and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.

combos.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Cast Walking Ballista by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Walking Ballista, adding {C}{C}.
When Walking Ballista dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Walking Ballista from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Nurturing Pixie from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Nurturing Pixie enters, it triggers, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Nurturing Pixie
Repeat.

Cast the creature with mana cost {0} from your hand by paying {0}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning the other creature with mana cost {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: One of the creatures with mana cost {0} must be in your hand with the other being on the battlefield.

combos.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Hollowhenge Overlord triggers, creating six 2/2 Wolf creature tokens for each Wolf and/or Werewolf you control due to Ojer Taq and Anointed Procession.
Repeat step 1 during each of your upkeeps. You'll create exponentially more Wolves each time assuming the Wolf tokens survive.

Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Scaled Herbalist.
Repeat.

Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.
combos.prerequisites: You have a way to gain life.

combos.description:
Activate Shao Jun by tapping two artifacts, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure for each opponent dealt damage this way.
Repeat.

Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Funeral Room triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a creature token.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.

results: Target opponent loses the game at the beginning of their next upkeep
combos.description:
Cast Heartless Act by paying {1}{B}, removing up to three oil counters from Archfiend of the Dross.
Activate Coveted Falcon by paying {1}{U}, turning it face up.
Coveted Falcon triggers, causing an opponent to gain control of Archfiend of the Dross and causing you to draw a card.
At the beginning of the opponent's next upkeep, Archfiend of the Dross triggers, causing the opponent to remove an oil counter from it and lose the game.
combos.prerequisites: Your deck size is at least 2.

combos.description:
Cast Justiciar's Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Salvager of Secrets and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Salvager of Secrets trigger.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, returning Justiciar's Portal from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Justiciar's Portal.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Salvager of Secrets and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

results: Infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control
combos.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Daxos, Blessed by the Sun triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.

results: Infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control
combos.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, targeting itself, but putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

combos.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering Ravenous Squirrel, putting a +1/+1 counter on Ravenous Squirrel.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Cast Seasons Past by paying {4}{G}{G}, returning Mystical Tutor and Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand and putting Seasons Past onto the bottom of your library.
Cast Mystical Tutor by paying its mana cost, searching your library for Seasons Past and putting it on top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Seasons Past from your library.
Repeat.

results: Infinite copies of all tokens you control
combos.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Mondrak and creating four token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Put all but one Mondrak token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Ratadrabik triggers four times from the nontoken and token Mondraks dying.
Resolve the first trigger, creating 2^X nonlegendary token copies of Mondrak that are 2/2 Zombies, where X is the number of Mondraks you control plus one.
Repeat step 4 for the remaining triggers.

Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When Gruul Turf enters, it triggers.
Activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve Gruul Turf's triggered ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

results: Infinite mana lands you control can produce
Put all permanent cards from your graveyard and library onto the battlefield
combos.description:
Cast Lumra by paying {4}{G}{G}.
When Lumra enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 3 until you control no lands.
When you sacrifice the last land, Lumra will die as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Resolve the Lumra trigger from step 2, causing you to mill four cards and return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Lumra from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
combos.prerequisites:
You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
You do not have any static effects boosting your creatures' toughness.

Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Warrior token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.

At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain ten life and win the game.

Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Sakura-Tribe Scout.
Repeat.

results: Put all lands from your hand and library onto the battlefield
combos.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning the basic land from the battlefield to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
When the Illusion enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing the Illusion, causing you to draw a card and put the basic land from your hand onto the battlefield tapped, and then repeat this process once if you control eight or more lands, putting any other land from your hand onto the battlefield instead.
When the land enters the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the basic land.
Repeat.

Cast Mystic Speculation with buyback by paying {0} due to Aang's cost reduction, causing you to scry 3 and return Mystic Speculation to your hand.
Repeat.

results: Infinite copies of abilities you control on the stack
Infinite +1/+1 counters on an infinite number of creature tokens
combos.description:
Cast Writhing Chrysalis by paying {2}{R}{G}.
Ulalek triggers twice, and Writhing Chrysalis' first ability triggers once.
Resolve one of Ulalek's triggers, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy the Writhing Chrysalis spell, Ulalek's trigger and Writhing Chrysalis' trigger.
Resolve the copy of Writhing Chrysalis' trigger, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate both Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens by sacrificing it, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the copy of Ulalek's trigger from step 3, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy the Writhing Chrysalis spell, Ulalek's trigger and Writhing Chrysalis' trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

results: Each opponent sacrifices all permanents they control
combos.description:
Cast Balancing Act by paying {2}{W}{W}.
Holding priority, cast Perch Protection by paying {4}{W}{W} and choosing to promise an opponent a gift, causing all permanents you control to phase out and an opponent to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve Balancing Act, causing each opponent to sacrifice all their permanents as you control no permanents that aren't phased out.

Cast Leveler by paying {5}.
When Leveler enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling your library.
During your next upkeep step, activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your draw step, drawing Timestream Navigator from your library.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
Repeat from step 3 each turn.

When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Viridian Joiner.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {1} and tapping Appa.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0} and tapping Appa and the Ally token.
Repeat from step 4.

Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {2}{U}, targeting a basic Island.
Orvar triggers, creating a copy of the basic Island.
Resolve Whim of Volrath, returning it to your hand.
Repeat two additional times.
Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Walk the Aeons with buyback by paying {4}{U}{U} and sacrificing three Islands, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and return  Walk the Aeons to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

results: Infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control

Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature with at least one +1/+1 counter.
Basri's Lieutenant trigger, creating a 2/2 Knight token.
When Knight token enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

Activate the mutated Auspicious Starrix and Kiki-Jiki creature by tapping it, creating a token copy of it with haste.
Repeat.

Cast a copy of Channel by paying {G}{G}.
Activate the ability granted by Channel by paying 1 life, adding {C}.
Repeat step 2 as desired.
Cast Comet Storm by paying {R}{R} and all remaining available mana, dealing a large amount of damage to a set number of targets.

Cast Cursed Mirror by paying {2}{R}.
Choose to have Cursed Mirror enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel with haste.
When Cursed Mirror enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Cursed Mirror.
Repeat from step 2.

combos.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Geralf's Messenger
When Geralf's Messenger dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Messenger enters, it triggers, causing an opponent to lose 2 life
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Geralf's Messenger
When Geralf's Messenger dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Messenger enters, it triggers, causing an opponent to lose 2 life
Resolve both Spawning Pit abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.

Activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

Repeat step 1 as desired.

Resolve Exsanguinate, causing each opponent to lose X life, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.

Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token due to Quina.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

When Dread Tiller dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dread Tiller enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability
Repeat.

results: Return any number of creatures to their owners' hands
Return any creature to its owner's hand when it enters the battlefield
combos.description:

Activate Soratami Mirror Mage by paying {3} and returning the three lands from the battlefield to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Llanowar Scout.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 1.
Resolve all Soratami Mirror-Mage abilities, returning any number of creatures from the battlefield to their owners' hands.

combos.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing itself, adding {R}.
When Thermopod dies, Yedora triggers, returning Thermopod from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Activate Thermopod by tapping it, adding {G}.

Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger from step 2, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.

Gain life.

Shalai and Hallar triggers, dealing damage to an opponent and causing you to gain life.

Whenever a player casts an instant or sorcery spell, Eye of the Storm triggers, exiling that spell.
Because Arcane Laboratory prevents players from casting more than one spell each turn, players cannot cast the spell permitted by Eye of the Storm, or any other spell that turn.

combos.description:

Repeat.

Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.

Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Pincher.

Activate Horseshoe Crab by paying {U}.

 Resolve Horseshoe Crab's ability from step 2, untapping it.

Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Treasure, adding {C}{C}.

When Hostage Taker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.

Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Hostage Taker.

Resolve the second Dross Scorpion trigger from step 7, untapping Jan Jansen.

Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.
combos.prerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.

combos.description:
Cast Phyrexian Marauder by paying {0}.
Phyrexian Marauder enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Grim Haruspex.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Marauder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Grim Haruspex trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Phyrexian Marauder from your library.
Repeat.

Activate Whisperer of the Wilds by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Scryb Ranger by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Whisperer of the Wilds.
Cast Scryb Ranger by paying {1}{G}.
Repeat.

results: Each opponent sacrifices any creature that enters under their control
Each opponent sacrifices all creatures they control
combos.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing any other creature.
Dictate of Erebos triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
Overseer of the Damned triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token for each creature sacrificed.
Resolve the Woe Strider trigger, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop any time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent control.

Activate Jace's zero loyalty ability, putting Expropriate on top of your library.
Pass the turn.
On your next draw step, when you draw Expropriate, reveal it due to Kefnet's ability, making a copy that costs {2} less to cast.
Cast the copy for {5}{U}{U}, granting you an extra turn.

Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying X life, where X is the creature's mana value.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Repeat.

Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on Sporoloth Ancient.
Activate Sporoloth Ancient by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

results: Infinite charge counters on a permanent
combos.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Reluctant Role Model trigger.
Resolve Reluctant Role Model's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability from step 1.
Repeat.

Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback by paying {4}{G}, reduced by {1} for each creature you can tap as you cast it.
Each Stormsplitter you control triggers, creating that many token copies of Stormsplitter.
Resolve Sprout Swarm, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token and returning Sprout Swarm to your hand.
Repeat.

combos.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Mystic Barrier.
As the copy of Mystic Barrier enters the battlefield, choose the opposite direction that was chosen for the nontoken Mystic Barrier.
At the beginning of each of your upkeeps, keep the direction chosen for each Mystic Barrier.
As long as there are three or more players in the game, creatures cannot attack.

Cast Clever Impersonator by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Put the original Abdel Adrian into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide and Clever Impersonator's abilities trigger.
Resolve the Clever Impersonator ability, choosing to exile Karmic Guide until Clever Impersonator leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Clever Impersonator into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide and Abdel Adrian's abilities trigger.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian ability, exiling Karmic Guide until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Clever Impersonator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 2.

results: Infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control
combos.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Clue, adding {C}{C}.
Lonis and Sakashima the Impostor's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Sakashima the Impostor.
Sakashima the Impostor's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.

Gain any amount of life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Herd Baloth equal to the amount of life gained.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
The Beast enters the battlefield, triggering Ajani's Welcome, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

results: Infinite mana creatures you control can produce
combos.description:

Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning the land to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.

Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

Activate Quicksilver Elemental twice by paying {U}{U}, causing it to gain all activated abilities of Incubation Druid and Horseshoe Crab until end of turn.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Incubation Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Horseshoe Crab's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

Cast a copy of Improvised Act from exile by paying one mana, unpreparing Pompous Battlemage.
Displacer Kitten and Storm-Kiln Artist both trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten ability, flickering Biblioplex Tomekeeper.

Resolve the remaining trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana.

Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Put all land cards from your library and graveyard onto the battlefield

Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.

Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.

Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.

Birgi triggers, adding {R}.

combos.description:

Port Razer triggers, causing you to untap all creatures you control and get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Port Razer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

When Glorious Protector enters, it exiles Phantom Steed until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Glorious Protector's ETB.
When Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, Lumbering Battlement is returned from exile to the battlefield.

When Phantom Steed enters, it exiles Lumbering Battlement until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Phantom Steed's ETB.

Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.

When Boss's Chauffeur dies, its persist ability and second ability trigger.
Resolve the second trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Citizen creature tokens equal to the number of +1/+1 counters that were on Boss's Chauffeur.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Boss's Chauffeur from your graveyard to the battlefield. It'll enter with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the number of creatures you control minus 1 due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.

Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters, it and Tiller Engine each trigger.
Resolve Tiller Engine's ability, untapping Dimir Aqueduct.
Activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding two mana.

Activate Selvala by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Selvala enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Selvala.

When Uro enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities trigger, as well as Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
