Cast Vadrok either from your hand or from the command zone for its mutate cost by paying {1}{W/U}{R}{R} and commander tax, if applicable, putting it under any other nonlegendary non-Human creature you control.
Vadrok triggers, casting Cackling Counterpart from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve Cackling Counterpart, creating a copy of the Vadrok mutated creature.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {R}.
Cast Snap by paying {1}{U}.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve Snap, returning the mutated creature that contains the nontoken Vadrok from the battlefield to your hand and untapping two lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{W/U}.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {R}.
Activate two lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{W/U}.
Cast Vadrok for its mutate cost by paying {1}{W/U}{R}{R}, putting it under the token Vadrok mutated creature.
The nontoken and token Vadrok each trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Vadrok trigger, casting Cackling Counterpart from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve Cackling Counterpart, creating a copy of the Vadrok mutated creature.
Resolve the token Vadrok trigger from step 13, casting Snap from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve Snap, returning the  mutated creature that contains the nontoken Vadrok from the battlefield to your hand and untapping two lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{W/U}.
Activate Kykar twice by sacrificing two Spirits, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 12.
With each iteration, you will gain an additional Vadrok trigger, which you can use to cast any other noncreature spells with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard, and create infinite Spirit tokens due to Kykar.
combos.manaNeeded: {U}{R}{R}{R} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable

combos.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter for its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it exiles Phantom Steed until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Fiend Hunter's ETB.
When Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, Lumbering Battlement is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Lumbering Battlement enters, it exiles Fiend Hunter until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lumbering Battlement's ETB.
When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, Phantom Steed is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Phantom Steed enters, it exiles Lumbering Battlement until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Phantom Steed's ETB.
When Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, Fiend Hunter is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When the basic land enters, Tireless Provisioner and Bristly Bill trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Bristly Bill trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Salvager of Secrets.
When Salvager of Secrets and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Warp from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Warp during your draw step.
Repeat.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cult Conscript, adding {C}{C}
When Cult Conscript dies, Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cult Conscript enters, Carnival of Souls triggers, adding {B} and causing you to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

results: Win the game at the beginning of your next upkeep
combos.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Celestial Convergence triggers.
In response to the trigger, activate Vampire Hexmage by sacrificing it, removing all counters from Celestial Convergence.
Resolve Celestial Convergence's ability, winning the game due to being the player with the highest life total.

Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Skyshroud Ranger.
Repeat.

Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Selvala.
Monk Gyatso triggers. Choose not to airbend Selvala.
Resolve Lightning Greaves' ability, attaching it to Selvala.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {2}{G}
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Monk Gyatso.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Selvala.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Selvala.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Selvala from exile by paying {2}.
Repeat.

Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it triggers.
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve Simic Growth Chamber's triggered ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

results: Infinite mana creatures you control can produce
combos.description:
Activate Pestered Wellguard by tapping it.
Pestered Wellguard triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
When the Faerie enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat

Cast Stonecoil Serpent by paying {0}.
Stonecoil Serpent enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Moldervine Reclamation.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Stonecoil Serpent from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Stonecoil Serpent from your library, and gain 1 life.
Repeat.

Cast Stonecoil Serpent by paying {0}.
Stonecoil Serpent enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Fecundity.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Stonecoil Serpent from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Fecundity trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Stonecoil Serpent from your library.
Repeat.

Put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

combos.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Fanatic of Rhonas's ability by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

Cast Abdel Adrian from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and command tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Faceless Butcher and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from exile to the battlefield.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and re-enters the battlefield, causing Faceless Butcher to return from exile to the battlefield, and triggering both Faceless Butcher and Abdel Adrian's abilities.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger, exiling Felidar Guardian until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Faceless Butcher and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

results: Near-infinite blinking of nonland permanents you control
combos.description:
Cast Blur by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Salvager of Secrets and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Salvager of Secrets trigger.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, returning Blur from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Blur.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Salvager of Secrets and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

combos.description:

Activate the creature by paying {1} due to Agatha of the Vile Cauldron and untapping it, giving itself +2/+2 until end of turn.

When Charming Scoundrel enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Charming Scoundrel.
Resolve both Charming Scoundrel triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.

Activate Goblin Welder by tapping it, sacrificing itself and returning Scrap Welder from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

When Pia and Kiran Nalaar enters, it triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Sanctum of Fruitful Harvest triggers.
Holding priority, activate Weaver of Harmony by paying {G} and tapping it, copying Sanctum of Fruitful Harvest's ability.
Resolve the copy of Sanctum of Fruitful Harvest's ability, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Weaver of Harmony.
Activate Weaver of Harmony by paying {G} and tapping it, copying Sanctum of Fruitful Harvest's ability.
Resolve the copy of Sanctum of Fruitful Harvest's ability, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Weaver of Harmony.

Tap Famished Paladin to create a 1/1 creature token.

Famished Paladin triggers, untapping itself.

Activate Volrath's Dungeon's second ability by discarding Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's third ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Volrath's Dungeon ability, causing target player to put a card from their hand on top of their library.
Repeat.

Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat, Totentanz and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Totentanz ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.

combos.description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying its mana cost.
When Scurry Oak enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Host of the Hereafter triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 5.

Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, targeting Swans of Bryn Argoll.
The damage that would be dealt to Swans of Bryn Argoll is prevented, and you draw a card instead.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate PuPu UFO by tapping it, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping PuPu UFO.
Repeat.

The token Kodama of the East Tree and Gruul Turf trigger.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the token Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
The nontoken Kodama of the East Tree and Gruul Turf trigger.

At the beginning of your end step, Blitzwing triggers, causing an opponent to lose life equal to the life they've lost this turn.

Declare Wanderwine Prophets as an attacker.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Wanderwine Prophets.
Wanderwine Prophets triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Merfolk token and take an extra turn after this one.
At the begining of your upkeep Extravagant Replication triggers creating a copy of a merfolk you control.
Repeat each turn.

You control at least one other merfolk.

Activate the artifact token by paying {4}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to gain control of target opponent during their next turn.

When Daretti enters the battlefield, it and Genesis Chamber trigger.
Resolve the Genesis Chamber trigger, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Resolve the Daretti trigger, causing you to sacrifice the Myr to return Cursed Mirror from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Daretti.
Put Cursed Mirror into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cursed Mirror and Genesis Chamber trigger.
Resolve the Genesis Chamber trigger, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Resolve the Cursed Mirror trigger, causing you to sacrifice the Myr to return Cursed Mirror from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Daretti.
Repeat from step 5

When the creature dies, Yedora triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land and as a 1/1 creature due to Living Plane.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

combos.description:

Activate Pili-Pala's other ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding two mana of any one color.

Cast Marketback Walker by paying {1} due to Foundry Inspector, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Marketback Walker.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Marketback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Marketback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Marketback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.

Fetch a land using Vibrant Cityscape.
When the fetched land enters, Rampaging Baloths and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Rampaging Baloths trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Rampaging Baloths triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Vibrant Cityscape.

combos.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Sifter of Skulls, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Repeat.

Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with mana value 0.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning the creature that creates creature token(s) on death from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature.
When the creature dies, it and Sidisi trigger.
Resolve the Sidisi trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the creature's trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Deal damage to yourself or a permanent you control, with that damage being redirected to Palisade Giant.
Arcbond triggers, dealing damage equal to the damage dealt to Palisade Giant to each other creature and each player, with all damage that would be dealt to you and creatures you control being dealt to Palisade Giant instead.

Archmage Emeritus triggers, causing you to draw a card.

Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.

Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.

Cast Lumbering Battlement by paying {4}{W}.
When Lumbering Battlement enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Wormfang Drake to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Lumbering Battlement.
Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Abdel Adrian to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Wormfang Drake and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating at least one 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Lumbering Battlement to the battlefield from exile.
Repeat from step 2.
Cast Abdel Adrian for its mana cost.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it exiles Lumbering Battlement until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Abdel Adrian's ETB.
When Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, Wormfang Drake is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it exiles Abdel Adrian until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Wormfang Drake's ETB.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Lumbering Battlement is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Lumbering Battlement enters, it exiles Wormfang Drake until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lumbering Battlement's ETB.
When Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
