combos.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Grand Architect by tapping a blue creature you control except Unctus, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to cast artifact spells or to activate abilities of artifacts.
The creature triggers, causing you to loot.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Repeat.

Activate Nomads en-Kor's first ability by paying {0}, targeting Daru Spiritualist.
Daru Spiritualist triggers, causing itself to get +0/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Nomads en-Kor ability, causing the next one damage dealt to Nomads en-Kor this turn to be dealt to Daru Spiritualist instead.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Cast Worthy Cause by paying {W} and sacrificing Daru Spiritualist, causing you to gain life equal to Daru Spiritualist's toughness.

Cast Malignus by paying {3}{R}{R}.
When Malignus enters the battlefield, Warstorm Surge triggers, dealing an amount of damage equal to twice Malignus' power to an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

results: Put all basic lands from your library onto the battlefield tapped
combos.description:
Activate Thawing Glaciers by paying {1} and tapping it, searching your library for a basic land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Amulet of Vigor and Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping the basic land.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Thawing Glaciers.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

Sacrifice Oathsworn Vampire for {B}.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard.
Tormod triggers, creating a tapped 2/2 Zombie token.
Sacrifice the Zombie token for {B}.
Repeat.

Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, getting an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Mnemonic Wall.
Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Fetch a land using Escape Tunnel.
When the fetched land enters, Tireless Tracker and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Tireless Tracker trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Tireless Tracker triggers.
Repeat from step 5.
combos.prerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Escape Tunnel.

combos.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Memnite
When Memnite dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Memnite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Memnite from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

Activate Zul Ashur by tapping it, targeting Shambling Ghast.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Shambling Ghast, adding {C}{C}.
When Shambing Ghast dies, it and Zul Ashur trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Zul Ashur trigger, untapping it.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites:
Zul Ashur, Lich Lord does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Zul Ashur.

combos.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Ornithopter from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Ornithopter from your graveyard by paying {0}.
When Ornithopter enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ornithopter.
When Ornithopter dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Emry.

results: Infinite untap of permanents you control
Infinite mana permanents you control can produce
combos.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mnemonic Wall and Shipwreck Dowser.
When Mnemonic Wall and Shipwreck Dowser enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Activate Whisper by tapping it and sacrificing two other nontoken creatures.
Pawn of Ulamog, Zulaport Cutthroat and Whisper each trigger twice.
Resolve both Pawn of Ulamog triggers, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Resolve both Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain two life.
Resolve both Whisper triggers, untapping it.
Resolve the Whisper ability from step 1, returning target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Whisper by tapping it and sacrificing an Eldrazi Spawn token and any other nontoken creature.
Pawn of Ulamog triggers once, while Zulaport Cutthroat and Whisper each trigger twice.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Repeat from step 4.

results: Infinite mana lands you control can produce
Put all land cards from your library and graveyard onto the battlefield
Reduce the toughness of creatures opponents control to 0
combos.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Eternal Witness and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Eternal Witness and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
When the land(s) enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the land(s)
Repeat.

Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Ambrosia Whiteheart from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Ambrosia Whiteheart enters, it triggers, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ambrosia Whiteheart
Repeat.
Maralen prevents players from drawing, but allows tutors, Mindlock Orb prevents players from tutoring

Cast Hulking Metamorph by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian
When Hulking Metamorph enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Hulking Metamorph. Choose to have Hulking Metamorph enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.
combos.prerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Hulking Metamorph.

combos.description:
During your cleanup step, discard down to your maximum hand size.
Confessor triggers for each card discarded this way.
Resolve the first Confessor trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Drogskol Reaver triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat steps 3 and 4 until no Confessor triggers remain.
Since you are still in the cleanup step, you must discard down to your maximum hand size again, repeating from step 1.
End the loop by declining to gain life with the remaining Confessor abilities.

results: Exile all cards in hands and graveyards
combos.description:
Cast Worldfire by paying {6}{R}{R}{R}, exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, and setting each player's life total to one.
Cast Mogis from the command zone by paying {2}{B}{R} and commander tax, if applicable.
At the beginning of an opponent's upkeep, Mogis triggers, dealing 2 damage to them as they are unable to sacrifice a creature.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining opponent.
combos.manaNeeded: {8}{B}{R}{R}{R}{R} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable

combos.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Host of the Hereafter triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.

Play Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it, Thranduil, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it and Thranduil trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

results: Infinite mana creatures you control can produce
Infinite untap of creatures you control
combos.description:
Activate Brigid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Kogla by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Brigid
Repeat.

Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Roaring Earth
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.
combos.prerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.

combos.description:
Cast Persist by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Persist.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Persist, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Persist copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Reluctant Role Model's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.

Cast Karmic Guide by paying {3}{W}{W}.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Metamorphosis Fanatic trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat form step 2.

Activate Urza by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Urza enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Urza.
Resolve the Urza trigger, creating two 0/0 Construct artifact creature tokens.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping the Constructs, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: Deadeye Navigator paired with Urza.

combos.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers if it didn't have a -1/-1 counter, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if Wingrattle Scarecrow didn't have flying.
Resolve the persist trigger, if applicable, returning Wingrattle Scarecrow from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning Wingrattle Scarecrow from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if the creature is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: You do not control a blue creature.

results: Infinite mana lands you control can produce
Infinite untap of lands you control
combos.description:
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {C}, blinking Cloud of Faeries.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to two lands.
Repeat.

results: Infinitely large creature until end of turn
combos.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing a Food.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure artifact token, a tapped Clue artifact token and a tapped Food artifact token.
Resolve the ability from step 1.
Repeat.

results: Infinite power and toughness for most creatures you control until end of turn
combos.description:
Activate Pili-Pala by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {1} due to Agatha of the Vile Cauldron and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it for Agatha of the Vile Cauldron's ability.

Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature.
The creature dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, untapping it and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

results: Infinite recursion of creature cards in your graveyard
combos.description:
Cast Storm of Souls by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Storm of Souls.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Storm of Souls
Resolve the Storm of Souls copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

results: Infinite copies of permanents you control
Infinite mana lands and artifacts you control can produce
combos.description:
Cast Deepglow Skate by paying {4}{U}.
Deepglow Skate triggers, doubling the number of counters on Saheeli.
Activate Saheeli's -7 ability to create a token copy all permanents you control.
Put the oldest Saheeli, The Gifted into the graveyard with the legend rule.
The Deepglow Skate token triggers, doubling the number of counters on the remaining Saheeli.
Repeat from step 3.

results: Infinite untap of creatures you control
Infinite mana creatures you control can produce
combos.description:
Declare Aurelia as an attacker.
Aurelia triggers, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, making it so the next time Aurelia dies this turn it will be returned to the battlefield.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Aurelia.
Adarkar Valkyrie triggers, returning Aurelia to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia's ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Aurelia's power.
Repeat.

results: Infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control
Win the game at the beginning of your next upkeep
combos.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra's second ability and Nuka-Cola Vending Machine trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Nuka-Cola Vending Machine trigger, creating a tapped Treasure token. The Treasure will enter as a 7/7 Dinosaur Food in addition to its types due to Displaced Dinosaurs and Ygra.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: You control another Food.

results: Infinite copies of all tokens you control
combos.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Mondrak and creating four token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Put all but one Mondrak token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Ratadrabik triggers four times from the nontoken and token Mondraks dying.
Resolve the first trigger, creating 2^X nonlegendary token copies of Mondrak that are 2/2 Zombies, where X is the number of Mondraks you control plus one.
Repeat step 5 for the remaining triggers.

results: Infinite recursion of creature cards in your graveyard
combos.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}, returning Eternal Witness and at least three other creatures from graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Afterlife from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four of the creatures returned in step 1, including Eternal Witness, adding {4}.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

Equip Phyrexian Walker with Umbral Mantle.
Sacrifice Phyrexian Walker to Goblin Bombardment to deal 1 damage to any target.
Koll triggers, returning Phyrexian Walker to you hand.
Cast Phyrexian Walker.
Repeat.

Cast Lagrella for its mana cost.
When Lagrella enters, it exiles Werefox Bodyguard until Lagrella leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lagrella's ETB.
When Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield, All-Fates Stalker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When All-Fates Stalker enters, it exiles Lagrella until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of All-Fates Stalker's ETB.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Werefox Bodyguard is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it exiles All-Fates Stalker until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Werefox Bodyguard's ETB.
When All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield, Lagrella is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
combos.prerequisites: All-Fates Stalker must be exiled by Werefox Bodyguard, and Lagrella must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
combos.manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand

combos.description:
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Llanowar Scout.
Repeat.

Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Heronblade Elite.
Activate Mimeoplasm by tapping it, adding at least seven {G}.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Gilder Bairn.
Activate Mimeoplasm using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it.
Repeat.

Play Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it, Sapling Nursery, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sapling Nursery trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and Sapling Nursery trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

Cast Sozin's Comet from your hand by paying {3}{R}{R} or from exile for its foretell cost by paying {2}{R}, giving each creature you control firebending 5 until end of turn.
Declare The Incredible Hulk as an attacker. Its firebending ability triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Pyrohemia by paying {R}, dealing 1 damage to each creature and player.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, untapping it and giving you an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.
combos.prerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Incredible Hulk.

combos.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, The Necrobloom triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: You control a land.

combos.description:
Activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}.
Activate another mana producing land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Cloud of Faeries.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Selesnya Sanctuary and another mana-producing land.
Repeat.

Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Repeat

results: Put all creature cards from your library onto the battlefield tapped
combos.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Evereth by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Reyhan trigger.
Resolve Reyhan's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Evereth ability from step 1.
Repeat.

results: Infinite mana lands you control can produce
combos.description:
Play Lotus Field. When it enters untapped due to Archelos, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Resolve the Lotus Field trigger, sacrificing it and Echoing Deeps.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos. Choose to have Echoing Deeps enter as a copy of Lotus Field.
When Echoing Deeps and Lotus Field enter, they each trigger.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps, Lotus Field and two other mana-producing lands except Shifting Woodland by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Resolve the Echoing Deeps and Lotus Field triggers, sacrificing them and the lands tapped for mana in step 6.
Activate Shifting Woodland's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos. Choose to have Echoing Deeps enter as a copy of Lotus Field.
Repeat from step 5.

results: Infinite draw triggers for any number of opponents
Infinite card draw for any number of opponents
combos.description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create four Treasure tokens due to Adrix and Nev and Mondrak.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.

Cast Coveted Jewel by paying its mana cost.
When Coveted Jewel enters, it and Ultron trigger.
Resolve the Coveted Jewel trigger, causing you to draw three cards.
Holding priority, activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Resolve the Ultron trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a copy of Coveted Jewel that is a 2/2 Robot Villain creature.
When the Coveted Jewel token enters, it triggers, causing you to draw three cards.
During your next turn, activate the Coveted Jewel token by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping the Coveted Jewel token.
Repeat from step 7.
combos.prerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your library

results: Prevent all damage that would be dealt to you
combos.description:
Activate Heidar by paying {2} and tapping it, returning The One Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast The One Ring by paying {4}.
The One Ring triggers, giving you protection from everything until your next turn.
Repeat each turn.

Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the Forest that enters untapped.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 3.
combos.prerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.

combos.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Palladium Myr.
Monk Gyatso triggers. Choose not to airbend Palladium Myr.
Resolve Lightning Greaves' ability, attaching it to Palladium Myr.
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Monk Gyatso.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Palladium Myr.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Palladium Myr.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Palladium Myr from exile by paying {2}.
Repeat.

results: Prevent all damage that would be dealt to you
combos.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: You control another land.

combos.description:
Activate Chameleon using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Chameleon by paying {1}{U}, blinking it. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
When Chameleon enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Chameleon.
Repeat each turn.
combos.manaNeeded: {1}{U} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn

combos.description:
Cast Wheel of Misfortune by paying {2}{R}, choosing an arbitrarily large number and having Wheel of Misfortune deal that much damage to Wrathful Red Dragon instead of you due to Pariah's Shield if you chose the largest number.
Wrathful Red Dragon triggers, dealing that much damage to an applicable target.

Cast Cryptic Trilobite by paying {0}.
Cryptic Trilobite enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Liliana, Dreadhorde General.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Cryptic Trilobite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Liliana, Dreadhorde General trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Cryptic Trilobite from your library.
Repeat.

Cast Marketback Walker by paying {0}.
Marketback Walker enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Liliana, Dreadhorde General.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Marketback Walker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Liliana, Dreadhorde General trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Marketback Walker from your library.
Repeat.

Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {0}.
Hangarback Walker enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Liliana, Dreadhorde General.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Hangarback Walker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Liliana, Dreadhorde General trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Hangarback Walker from your library.
Repeat.

results: Infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control
combos.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Triskelion.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.

At the beginning of your upkeep, Stasis and Thopter Spy Network's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Thopter Spy Network trigger, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping the Thopter, adding {U}.
Resolve the Stasis trigger, causing you to pay {U}.
Repeat during each of your turns.
As long as Stasis is on the battlefield, players skip their untap steps.

Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Soulstinger.
When Soulstinger dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Soulstinger enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability
Repeat.

results: Destroy all creatures opponents control whenever a creature enters the battlefield
combos.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

Cast Invasion of Arcavios by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning up to one nonland permanent to its owner's hand.
When Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand, or searching your library for Temporal Manipulation and putting it into your hand, if needed.
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Invasion of Arcavios to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Carnifex Demon.
When Carnifex Demon dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability
Repeat.

results: Infinite untap of permanents you control
Infinite mana permanents you control can produce
combos.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Tidewater Minion's last ability by tapping it, untapping Lotus Field.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Tidewater Minion.
Repeat any number of times.
Repeat steps with a different color for infinite mana of any color.

Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {1} due to Cloud Key, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Hangarback Walker.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Hangarback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Hangarback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Hangarback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: "Artifact" or "Creature" chosen with Cloud Key

combos.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Fumulus trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Squee and Skyfire Phoenix, adding {R}{R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R}.
Skyfire Phoenix triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

results: Near-infinite mana lands you control can produce
Near-infinite untap of lands you control
combos.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Frantic Search by paying {2}{U}.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Frantic Search.
Resolve the copy of Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap Minamo, Lotus Field and up to other land.
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Kitsa.
Repeat from step 4.

Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield on top of your library.
Activate the mana-producing artifact or creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking the mana-producing artifact or creature.
Repeat.

Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {2}.
Bygone Bishop triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Clue and Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {3}.
Bygone Bishop triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Repeat.

Activate Slobad by tapping it and sacrificing Junk Diver, adding {R}{R}{R} that can only be spent to activate abilities of artifacts or to cast artifact spells.
Junk Diver dies, triggering itself and Slobad.
Resolve the Junk Diver trigger, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Slobad trigger, untapping it.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {2}.
Activate Slobad by tapping it and sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {R}{R} that can only be spent to activate abilities of artifacts or to cast artifact spells.
Myr Retriever dies, triggering itself and Slobad.
Resolve the Myr Retriever trigger, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Slobad trigger, untapping it.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {3}.
Repeat.

Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Sol Ring by tapping them, adding {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Sol Ring.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: You control three additional Islands.

combos.description:
Cast Gray Merchant of Asphodel by paying {3} and 4 life.
Gray Merchant of Asphodel enters the battlefield, causing each opponent to lose 7 life and gaining you 21 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Gray Merchant of Asphodel, adding {B}.
Activate Phyrexian Reclamation by paying {1} and 4 life, returning Gray Merchant of Asphodel from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Blood Celebrant by paying 6 life, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

results: Destroy each creature that enters the battlefield under an opponent's control
combos.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Vein Ripper triggers, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.

results: Infinite charge counters on a permanent
combos.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, targeting Karmic Guide
Holding priority, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki
Resolve the Kiki-Jiki ability, creating a token copy of Karmic Guide with haste.
When the Karmic Guide token enters, it triggers, returning Kiki-JIki from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {G}{U}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
Repeat from step 2.

results: Put all artifact creature cards with mana value 2 or less from your library onto the battlefield
Put all artifact creature cards with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard onto the battlefield
combos.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Phyrexian Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Phyrexian Metamorph enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Phyrexian Metamorph.
Resolve the Phyrexian Metamorph trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Phyrexian Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Krenko triggers, causing you to pay {R} to create a 1/1 Goblin creature token with haste.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Goblin token.
When the Goblin dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: You control at least one Treasure.

combos.description:
Activate Saffi Eriksdotter by sacrificing it.
When Saffi Eriksdotter dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Saffi Eriksdotter from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Saffi Eriksdotter ability.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: You control another creature.

combos.description:
Cast Aethertide Whale by paying eight {E} if able or {4}{U}{U} otherwise.
When Aethertide Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get twelve {E}.
Activate Aethertide Whale by paying {E}{E}{E}{E}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: You have either {4}{U}{U} or eight {E} available.

combos.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: Necrogen Communion attached to Brotherhood Outcast.

results: Infinite mana creatures you control can produce
combos.description:
Activate Zul Ashur by tapping it, targeting a Zombie card in your graveyard.
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding enough mana to cast the Zombie.
Cast the Zombie from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Zombie, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Repeat.

Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature with a coin counter on it.
When the creature dies, Athreos's second ability and Reluctant Role Model's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting a coin counter on it if it wasn't the creature that was sacrificed, or another nontoken creature you control otherwise.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

Declare Mist-Syndicate Naga as an attacker.
When it isn't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{B}.
Activate Palinchron's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{B} and returning Mist-Syndicate Naga from the battlefield to your hand, putting Palinchron onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Mist-Syndicate Naga's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U} and returning Palinchron from the battlefield to your hand, putting Mist-Syndicate Naga onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

results: Infinite power and toughness for most creatures you control until end of turn
combos.description:
Activate Pili-Pala by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {1} due to Agatha of the Vile Cauldron and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it for Agatha of the Vile Cauldron's ability.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cult Conscript, adding {B}.
When Cult Conscript dies, Totentanz triggers, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Rat, adding {1}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Repeat.

results: Infinitely large creature until end of turn
Infinite untap of creatures you control
Infinite mana creatures you control can produce
combos.description:
Activate Gyre Engineer by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Activate Gyre Engineer by paying {1} and untapping it, giving itself +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {W}.
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, coping Clever Conjurer' ability, targetting the mana-producing permanent.
Resolve both Clever Conjurer abilities, untapping Halo Fountain and the mana-producing permanent.
Activate Halo Fountain's first ability by paying {W}, tapping it and untapping Clever Conjurer, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
Repeat.

Cast Sakashima either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{U} and commander tax, if applicable, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
When Sakashima enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Sakashima leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Clever Impersonator returns from exile to the battlefield as a copy of Sakashima.
When Clever Impersonator enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Sakashima until Clever Impersonator leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Sakashima leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Clever Impersonator until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Clever Impersonator leaves the battlefield, Sakashima returns to the battlefield from exile as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 2.
combos.manaNeeded: {3}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable

combos.description:
Activate Patrol Signaler and another creature you control by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Activate Patrol Signaler by paying {1}{W} and untapping it, creating a 1/1 Kithkin Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

Cast Last Chance by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and to lose the game at the beginning of that turn's end step.
Activate Magar by paying {1}{B}{R}, noting Last Chance and putting it face down on the battlefield as a 3/3 creature.
During your next turn, deal combat damage to an opponent using the face down creature that has Last Chance noted.
The creature triggers, casting a copy of Last Chance without paying its mana cost. Resolve the copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and to lose the game at the beginning of that turn's end step.
Activate Sundial of the Infinite by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to end the turn. This will prevent the Last Chance trigger from causing you to lose the game.
Repeat from step 3.

Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it trigger, returning Angel of Indemnity from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Animate Dead to it.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, targeting Dance of the Dead.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Angel of Indemnity.
Resolve the Angel of Indemnity trigger, returning Dance of the Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it trigger, returning Angel of Indemnity from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, targeting Animate Dead.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Angel of Indemnity.
Resolve the Angel of Indemnity trigger, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

results: Infinite copies of a specific land
combos.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Tireless Provisioner each trigger twice.
Resolve both Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating two Treasure tokens. 
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
Repeat from step 3.
combos.prerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.

results: Cast a portion of the cards in your library and hand without paying their mana costs
Near-infinitely large creatures until end of turn
combos.description:
Activate Alaundo the Seer by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and exile a card from your hand with time counters on it equal to its mana value, then removing a time counter from each other card you own in exile.
Inspiring Refrain triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping Alaundo the Seer.
Resolve Inspiring Refrain, causing you to draw two cards, then exiling Inspiring Refrain with three time counters on it.
Activate Alaundo the Seer by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and exile a card from your hand with time counters on it equal to its mana value, then removing a time counter from each other card you own in exile.
Venture Forth triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping Alaundo the Seer.
Resolve Venture Forth, causing you to exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a land card, then putting the land card onto the battlefield and the rest of the cards exiled this way on the bottom of your library, and then exiling Venture Forth with three time counters on it.
Activate Alaundo the Seer by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and exile a card from your hand with time counters on it equal to its mana value, then removing a time counter from each card you own in exile.
Cyclical Evolution triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping Alaundo the Seer.
Resolve Cyclical Evolution, giving target creature +3/+3 until end of turn and then exiling Cyclical Evolution with three time counters on it.
Repeat.

Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Good-Fortune Unicorn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat

Cast Aethertide Whale by paying eight {E} if able or {4}{U}{U} otherwise.
When Aethertide Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, causing you to get twelve {E}.
Activate Aethertide Whale by paying {E}{E}{E}{E}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: You have either {4}{U}{U} or eight {E} available.

combos.description:
Activate Thran Dynamo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Thran Dynamo.
Repeat.

Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and get {E}.
Repeat.

Cast Wick either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Wick enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, if you control a Snail, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Snail, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Wick trigger, creating a 1/1 Snail creature token.
When the Snail enters the battlefield as a Rat due to Arcane Adaptation, Wick and Blasting Station trigger.
Repeat from step 3.
combos.manaNeeded: {3}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable

combos.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Puppeteer Clique, adding {1}.
Puppeteer Clique dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Puppeteer Clique enters the battllefield, putting a creature card from an opponent's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the creature your opponent owns, putting a +1/+1 counter on Puppeteer Clique.
Repeat.

Activate Stimulus Package by sacrificing a Treasure, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Citizen.
The Citizen dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Lagrella and any other artifact, creature or land you control.
When Lagrella enters the battlefield, it and Preston triggers.
Resolve the Lagrella trigger, exiling Sun Titan until Lagrella leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Lagrella that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Put the nontoken Lagrella into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
If Lagrella is your commander, choose not to return it to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Sun Titan is returned to the battlefield from exile.
Sun Titan, Lagrella and Preston each trigger.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Sun Titan that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Sun Titan token enters the battlefield, it triggers, choosing to return nothing to the battlefield.
Resolve the Lagrella trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on the nontoken Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger from step 8, returning Lagrella from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

results: Cast a subset of spells in your graveyard
Infinite mana lands you control can produce
Infinite untap of lands you control
combos.description:
Cast Vadrok for its mutate cost by paying {1}{W/U}{R}{R}, merging it under Peregrine Drake.
The Peregrine Drake mutated creature's ability from Vadrok triggers, casting Twinflame from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Twinflame, creating a token copy of the Peregrine Drake mutated creature with haste.
The token copy of the Peregrine Drake mutated creature triggers, untapping five lands you control.
Cast Snap by paying {1}{U}, returning the nontoken Peregrine Drake and Vadrok from the battlefield to your hand and untapping two lands you control.
Cast Vadrok for its mutate cost by paying {1}{W/U}{R}{R}, merging it under the token Peregrine Drake mutated creature.
The token Peregrine Drake mutated creature triggers once for each of its Vadrok abilities.
Resolve one of these triggers, casting Twinflame from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Twinflame, creating a token copy of the Peregrine Drake mutated creature with haste.
The token copy of the Peregrine Drake mutated creature triggers, untapping five lands you control.
Resolve a second trigger from step 7, casting Snap from your graveyard without paying its mana cost, targeting the mutated creature that includes the nontoken Vadrok.
Resolve Snap, returning Vadrok from the battlefield to your hand as well as multiple token creatures which cease to exist, and untapping two lands you control.
Resolve any remaining triggers from step 7, casting any noncreature cards with mana value 3 or less that were not already cast since step 7 from your graveyard without paying their casting costs.
Repeat from step 6, adding one additional token Vadrok to each new iteration of the Peregrine Drake mutated creature token.

results: Infinitely powerful creature until end of turn
combos.description:
Activate Satsuki by tapping it, putting a lore counter on There and Back Again.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Hex Parasite by paying {1}{B/P}, removing a lore counter from There and Back Again and giving Hex Parasite +1/+0 until end of turn.
Resolve the There and Back Again ability, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token.
If you control two Smaugs, put one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
If you do, the Smaug that died triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
If you made Treasures this way, activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}{B}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Smaug.
Repeat.
combos.manaNeeded: {1}{B/P}, plus an additional {1}{U}{B/P} available if you do not control a Smaug token

results: Infinitely large creature until end of turn
Infinite untap of creatures you control
Infinite mana creatures you control can produce
combos.description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.

Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Dinosaur token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Azor.
Azor enters the battlefield, preventing opponents from casting instants or sorceries during their next turn.

When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enter the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.

combos.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, copying another nonlegendary Saga you control and putting two to three lore counters on it.
The Saga tokens first through fourth chapter abilities trigger, as applicable. Resolve all triggers, and sacrifice the Saga token upon resolving the final trigger.
When the Saga token leaves the battlefield, Resourceful Defense triggers, moving the lore counters from the Saga token onto Esper Terra.
Esper Terra's second, third and fourth chapter abilities trigger.
Resolve the second and third chapter abilities.
Resolve the fourth chapter ability, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G} and then exiling Esper Terra and returning it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
Resourceful Defense and Terra, Magical Adept trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, moving all counters from Esper Terra onto any other permanent
Resolve the Terra, Magical Adept trigger, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

If needed, give control of Dandân to an opponent who controls no Islands.
