The creature dies, triggering Ravenous Squirrel, putting a +1/+1 counter on Ravenous Squirrel.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

results: Win the game at the beginning of your next upkeep
combos.description:
Cast Army of the Damned by paying {5}{B}{B}{B}, creating thirteen 2/2 Zombie and thirteen 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Epic Struggle triggers, causing you to win the game.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a green nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Verdant Succession and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, returning the creature from your library to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U}.
Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Kobolds of Kher Keep from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Kobolds of Kher Keep enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Enkira, adding {C}{C}.
Enkira dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Enkira from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Enkira enters the battlefield, creating two 2/2 Walker creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Walker, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Pawn of Ulamog, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1.
Repeat.

Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Host of the Hereafter triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 5.

Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Insidious Roots trigger.
Resolve the Insidious Roots trigger, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

Cast the self-suspending card by paying its mana cost if its in your hand, or any other spell otherwise if you have not cast a spell this turn.
Cast Karn's Temporal Sundering by paying its mana cost.
Taigam triggers, copying Karn's Temporal Sundering and then exiling it with four time counters on it and giving it suspend.
Resolve the copy of Karn's Temporal Sundering, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of that turn's upkeep, Karn's Temporal Sundering and the self-suspending card's suspend abilities trigger, removing a time counter from each of them.
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing three time counters from Karn's Temporal Sundering and the self-suspending card, triggering their suspend abilities.
Resolve the self-suspending card's suspend trigger, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost, and eventually exile it with time counters on it.
Resolve the Karn's Temporal Sundering's suspend trigger, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 3.
combos.prerequisites: You have a storm count of 1 if the self-suspending card is not in your hand, or a storm count of 0 otherwise.

combos.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

Cast Angel's Grace by paying {W}.
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Nine Lives and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, however you cannot lose the game due to Angel's Grace.
Cast Austere Command by paying its mana cost, destroying all enchantments.
When each opponent's Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, they each trigger, causing each opponent to lose the game.

results: Put most lands from your library and graveyard onto the battlefield tapped
combos.description:
Cast Cultivator Colossus by paying {4}{G}{G}{G}.
When Cultivator Colossus enters, it triggers, attempting to put Lake of the Dead from your hand onto the battlefield. Choose to instead put Lake of the Dead into your graveyard.
Afterwards, continue resolving the Cultivator Colossus trigger, causing you to mill two cards and return Lake of the Dead from your graveyard to your hand due to its dredge ability. Then, repeat the process, attempting to put Lake of the Dead from your hand onto the battlefield. Choose to instead put Lake of the Dead into your graveyard.
Repeat step 3.

results: Infinite mana permanents you control that enter the battlefield untapped can produce
combos.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, activate three permanents by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, targeting the tapped permanent and Pinnacle Monk
Fire Lord Azula triggers, copying Ghostly Flicker, targeting two other mana-producing permanents
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking the two targeted permanents.
Resolve the original Ghostly Flicker, blinking the targeted permanent and Pinnacle Monk
When Pinnacle Monk enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {3}{G}{U}.
Activate Selvala by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Selvala enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Selvala.
Repeat.

results: Put all lands with a basic land type from your library onto the battlefield tapped
combos.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Lotus Cobra and Dragonback Assault trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

results: Infinite black mana that can only be spent to cast instant and sorcery spells
Infinite blue mana that can only be spent to cast instant and sorcery spells
combos.description:
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant and/or sorcery spells.
Cast Molten Duplication by paying {1}{R}.
Urabrask triggers, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve Molten Duplication, creating a token copy of Cormela.
Put the tapped Cormela into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Cormela dies, it triggers, returning Molten Duplication from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kitchen Finks, adding {C}{C}.
Kitchen Finks' persist ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield with zero -1/-1 counters on it due to Grumgully.
Kitchen Finks entering the battlefield, causing you to gain two life.
Repeat.

results: Cast any number of spells from opponents' libraries
combos.description:
Cast Jace, Architect of Thought for {2}{U}{U} which enters with 8 loyalty counters due to Doubling Season.
Activate Jace's -8, putting it on the bottom of your library.
Search you library for Jace and exile it, and exile a nonland card of your choice.
Cast Jace along with any of the nonland cards you wish to cast.
Repeat from step 2.

results: Arrange your library in any order
Put all lands from your hand and library onto the battlefield tapped
combos.description:
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card, put it into your hand, then put the land onto the battlefield tapped, and repeat this process once if you control at least eight lands.
Retreat to Coralhelm and Mole Man trigger for each land that enters the battlefield this way.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger(s), untapping Zimone and Dina.
Resolve the Mole Man trigger(s), creating that many creature tokens.
Repeat.

Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing Sporuting Thrinax and Slimefoot and Squee.
When Slimefoot and Squee and Sprouting Thrinax die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice and Sprouting Thrinax triggers once.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Sprouting Thrinax trigger, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing two Saprolings.
When the Saprolings die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Yahenni abilities from steps 1 and 5.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and Sprouting Thrinax from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enter the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Thopter Foundry by paying {1} and sacrificing Sol Ring, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token and causing you to gain 1 life.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Thopter.
When the Thopter dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Sol Ring from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

results: Infinite copies of artifacts you control with haste
combos.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Nimblewright Schematic.
When Nimblewright Schematic enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Construct artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Construct and the Nimblewright Schematic token, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Nimblewright Schematic triggers, creating a 1/1 Construct artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Construct, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

results: Infinite +1/+1 counters on a creature token
combos.description:
Cast Omarthis either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Echoes of Eternity triggers, copying the Omarthis spell.
Resolve the copy of the Omarthis spell, creating a token copy of Omarthis with one +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the original Omarthis spell, causing it to enter the battlefield with one +1/+1 counter on it.
The token Omarthis's first ability triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the token Omarthis.
The nontoken Omarthis's first ability triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the nontoken Omarthis.
Repeat from step 5.
combos.manaNeeded: {2} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable

combos.description:
Cast Transcendence by paying {3}{W}{W}{W}.
Transcendence triggers due to you having 20 or more life. However, you cannot lose the game due to Darksteel Angel.
Step 2 repeats in an infinite loop, causing the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.
combos.prerequisites: Your life total is 20 or higher.

results: Tap all lands and creatures opponents control during each of your turns
Tap all lands and creatures during each opponent's upkeep step
combos.description:
At the beginning of each upkeep, Awakening and Sands of Time trigger.
If it is your turn, resolve the Sands of Time trigger, untapping each tapped permanent and tapping each untapped permanent.
Resolve the Awakening trigger, untapping all creatures and lands.
If it is not your turn, resolve the Sands of Time trigger, untapping each tapped permanent and tapping each untapped permanent.
Repeat during each turn.

results: Prevent all damage that would be dealt to you
combos.description:
Activate Temporal Adept by paying {U}{U}{U} and tapping it, returning The One Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast The One Ring by paying {4}.
The One Ring triggers, giving you protection from everything until your next turn.
Repeat each turn.

Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw two cards.
Lyla triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton
Repeat.

Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat
combos.prerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.

combos.description:
Activate Elenda's Hierophant by using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Elenda's Hierophant triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Essence Flux by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation and Essence Flux from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Mnemonic Wall by paying its mana cost.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Mnemonic Wall from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

results: Infinite mana lands you control can produce
Infinite untap of nontoken creatures you control
Infinite mana nontoken creatures you control can produce
Infinite untap of lands you control
combos.description:
Activate a mana-producing land  by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Hope Tender's second ability by paying {1}, tapping and exerting it, untapping Hope Tender and the mana-producing land.
Repeat.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Jousting Dummy, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Jousting Dummy from your graveyard by paying {2}.
Repeat.

Activate Pili-Pala using Paradise Mantle's ability by tapping it, adding two mana of any one color.
Activate Pili-Pala's other ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding two mana of any one color.
Repeat.

Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Venerated Stormsinger, Fumulus and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Fumulus ability, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Venerated Stormsinger triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.

combos.description:
Fetch a land using Escape Tunnel.
When the fetched land enters, Zendikar's Roil and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Zendikar's Roil trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Zendikar's Roil triggers.
Repeat from step 5.
combos.prerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Escape Tunnel.

results: Infinitely powerful Bird tokens you control until end of turn
combos.description:
Fetch a land using Myriad Landscape.
When the fetched land enters, Chocobo Racetrack and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Chocobo Racetrack trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Chocobo Racetrack from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Chocobo Racetrack triggers.
Repeat from step 5.
combos.prerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Myriad Landscape.
There are two basic land cards in your library that share a basic land type.

combos.description:
Fetch a land using Misty Rainforest.
When the fetched land enters, Sapling Nursery and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Sapling Nursery trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sapling Nursery from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Sapling Nursery triggers.
Repeat from step 5.
combos.prerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Misty Rainforest.
Your life total is 2 or higher.

results: Put all basic lands from your library onto the battlefield tapped
combos.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the basic land enters, Lotus Cobra and Bristly Bill trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Bristly Bill trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Ornithopter from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Ornithopter from your graveyard by paying {0}.
When Ornithopter enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ornithopter.
When Ornithopter dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Emry.

combos.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Notorious Throng by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Archaeomancer.
When Archaeomancer and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Notorious Throng from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Notorious Throng during your draw step.
Repeat.

Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warrior, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding an artifact creature card, returning another artifact creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Imotekh triggers, creating two 2/2 Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens.
When the Necron Warriors enter the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers twice, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a Necron Warrior.
When the Necron Warrior dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

At the beginning of your end step, Jon Irenicus triggers, giving control of Vodalian Knights to an opponent who controls no Islands.
When Vodalian Knights's controller controls no Islands, Vodalian Knights triggers, causing them to sacrifice it.
However, Vodalian Knights cannot be sacrificed due to its ability.
Vodalian Knights triggers again, creating a mandatory infinite loop that causes the game to end in a draw.

At the beginning of your end step, Jon Irenicus triggers, giving control of Kukemssa Serpent to an opponent who controls no Islands.
When Kukemssa Serpent's controller controls no Islands, Kukemssa Serpent triggers, causing them to sacrifice it.
However, Kukemssa Serpent cannot be sacrificed due to its ability.
Kukemssa Serpent triggers again, creating a mandatory infinite loop that causes the game to end in a draw.

All creatures lose flying and Islandwalk.
Moat prevents things without flying from attacking.
Creatures can not fulfill the conditions nessasary to attack.

Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki
Resolve the Kiki-Jiki ability, creating a token copy of Metamorphosis Fanatic with haste.
When the Metamorphosis Fanatic token enters, it triggers, returning Kiki-JIki from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, targeting Ioreth of the Healing House.
If Fatestitcher has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Fatestitcher ability, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, targeting Fatestitcher.
If Ioreth of the Healing House has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Ioreth of the Healing House ability, untapping Fatestitcher.
Repeat.

results: Each opponent sacrifices all creatures they control
combos.description:
Cast Fleshbag Marauder by paying its mana cost.
When Fleshbag Marauder enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Fleshbag Marauder dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Repeat from step 2

Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Mnemonic Wall and exiling Ephemerate.
When Mnemonic Wall enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Mnemonic Wall.
When Mnemonic Wall enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

results: Infinite untap of Samurai you control
Put all Equipment cards from your library onto the battlefield
Put all basic lands from your library onto the battlefield
combos.description:
Declare Godo and the Samurai with Sword of Hearth and Home attached as attackers.
Godo's second ability triggers, untapping it and all Samurai you control, and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using Godo and the Samurai that has Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
Sword of Hearth and Home triggers, causing you to exile Godo, then search your library for a basic land card and exile it, then put the land and Godo from exile onto the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

results: Infinite mana creatures you control can produce
Infinite untap of creatures you control
combos.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Otharri as attackers.
Otharri triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Moonshadow.
When Moonshadow dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability
Repeat.

Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dread Tiller.
When Dread Tiller dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dread Tiller enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability
Repeat.

Cast Planar Incision by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Chakra Meditation and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Chakra Meditation's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Chakra Meditation trigger, returning Planar Incision from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Planar Incision.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Chakra Meditation and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

results: Infinite card draw for any number of players
Infinite draw triggers for any number of players
Infinite token copies of Elementals you control
combos.description:
Cast Ashling's Command by paying {U}{R} due to Mizzix of the Izmagnus. Choose its fourth mode targeting yourself and then any other mode as desired.
If you had exactly three experience counters. Mizzix of the Izmagnus triggers, giving you an experience counter.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {R}{R} due to Mizzix of the Izmagnus, copying Ashling's Command with the fourth mode targeting yourself and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Ashling's Command, creating two Treasure tokens and performing the action of the other chosen mode.
Holding priority, activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, it and Baloth Prime trigger.
Resolve the land's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the Baloth Prime trigger, untapping it and creating a tapped 4/4 Beast creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: You control a land.

combos.description:
Deal damage to Spiteful Sliver.
Spiteful Sliver and Repercussion trigger.

When the creature dies, Dross Harvester, Open the Graves and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Open the Graves ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Dross Harvester triggers, causing you to gain 2 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.

Activate Thermopod's second ability twice by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warrior, adding {R}{R}.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Priest of Urabrask token, adding {C}{C}.

Once you have infinite colored mana, you may instead use Orthion's second ability to make copies of any creature(s) you control.

Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {1}{R}{R}.

Squee enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes, adding at least {C}{C}.

During your next turn, deal combat damage to an opponent using the face down creatures that have Warrior's Oath and Glorious End noted. The creatures trigger.

Resolve the second trigger, casting a copy of Glorious End without paying its mana cost. Resolve the copy, causing you to end the turn. This will prevent the Warrior's Oath trigger from causing you to lose the game.
Repeat from step 3.

Resolve the first trigger, casting a copy of Final Fortune without paying its mana cost. Resolve the copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and to lose the game at the beginning of that turn's end step.
Resolve the second trigger, casting a copy of Glorious End without paying its mana cost. Resolve the copy, causing you to end the turn. This will prevent the Final Fortune trigger from causing you to lose the game.

When Dryad Arbor dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Dryad Arbor enters the battlefield, Field of the Dead triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

Activate Radiant Lotus by tapping it and sacrificing two other artifacts, adding {6}.
Activate Retrofitter Foundry's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Retrofitter Foundry's first ability by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 one additional time.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Servos, untapping Radiant Lotus.
Repeat.

combos.description:

Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying 2 life.
Aetherflux Reservoir and Defiler of Flesh trigger.
Resolve the Aetherflux Reservoir trigger, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Resolve the Defiler of Flesh trigger, giving target creature +1/+1 and menace until end of turn.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite life, you may activate Aetherflux Reservoir's ability to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

results: Put all basic Swamps, Islands, and Mountains from your library onto the battlefield tapped
combos.description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Scaretiller and another artifact, targeting Scaretiller.
Scaretiller triggers, returning Maestros Theater from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Maestros Theater enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Toggo.
Resolve the Toggo trigger, creating a Rock equipment token.
Resolve the Maestros Theater trigger, causing you to sacrifice it then search your library for a basic Island, Mountain, or Swamp and put it onto the battlefield.
If you put a land onto the battlefield this way, Toggo triggers, creating a Rock equipment token.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability from step 1, untapping Scaretiller.
Repeat.

Activate Prototype Portal by paying {0} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Ancient Den.
The Ancient Den token enters, triggering Grinding Station, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Ancient Den token and Grinding Station, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.

Archetype of Imagination causes your opponent' creatures to lose flying and be unable to gain flying.
Form of the Dragon prevents non-flying creatures from attacking you, and since none of your opponent' creatures can have flying, no creatures can attack you.

Cast the noncreature spell.
Blood Funnel triggers; decline to sacrifice a creature and let the spell be countered.
Guile replaces Blood Funnel's countering of the spell; exile the spell and cast it for free again.
Blood Funnel triggers again; repeat this loop for infinite storm count.

results: Destroy each creature that enters the battlefield under an opponent's control
combos.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Relic Vial triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.

Repeat.

Your life total is at least 2.

Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.

When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Peregrine Drake enters, it triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, untapping five lands.
Holding priority, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.

When Ancestral Statue enters, it triggers twice, returning it and Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.

Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat

Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Declare any creature as an attacker. When you do, Doom's Time Platform triggers, exiling Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard with two time counters on it.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Temporal Manipulation's suspend ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Activate Rift Elemental by paying {1}{R} and removing a time counter from Temporal Manipulation.
Temporal Manipulation's suspend ability triggers, causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

Repeat from step 2.

Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the permanent you played in step 3 from the battlefield to your hand.

combos.description:
Activate Leech Bonder by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Leech Bonder by paying {U} and untapping it, moving a counter from target creature onto another creature.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Kinnan's ability.

Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds.
When Crookshank Kobolds dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Crookshank Kobolds to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
When Crookshank Kobolds enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two token copies of Mirage Mirror that are 3/3 Dragons in addition to their other types.
Activate the three Mirage Mirrors by paying {6}, causing each of them to become a copy of Biovisionary until end of turn.
At the beginning of your end step, Biovisionary and each Mirage Mirror trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

Cast Petals of Insight by paying {U}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Petals of Insight, putting the top three cards of your library on the bottom of your library, and returning Petals of Insight to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

results: Infinite mana lands you control can produce
Infinite untap of lands you control
combos.description:
Activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{W}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U}.
Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{W}{U}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

results: Cast a subset of spells in your graveyard
combos.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Mnemonic Wall and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
The two Mnemonic Wall tokens enter the battlefield, returning Sacrifice, if applicable, and Saw in Half from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Sacrifice by paying {B} and sacrificing a Mnemonic Wall token, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead return any other instant or sorcery that can be cast using only black mana in place of Sacrifice using the Mnemonic Wall tokens to get infinite casts of those instants and/or sorceries.

Play any land from your hand.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Felidar Retreat, creating a 2/2 Cat Beast creature token.
The Cat Beast enters the battlefield as a Saproling due to Maskwood Nexus, which also causes it to be a Forest land due to Life and Limb.
Felidar Retreat triggers, creating a 2/2 Cat Beast creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

Cast Rancor by paying {G}, attaching it to any other creature you control.
Siona triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with Rancor attached, adding {G}.
Rancor triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

Sacrifice Carrion Feeder to itself.
Untap all zombies.
Tap 5 untapped zombies you control to return Carrion Feeder to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Squee, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Squee from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding {C}{C}
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Cauldron of Essence triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Reassembling Skeleton enters, Davvol triggers, adding {B} and causing you to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding {B}
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Cauldron of Essence triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Reassembling Skeleton enters, Davvol triggers, adding {B} and causing you to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Luminous Phantom, Pawn of Ulamog and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Luminous Phantom trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog ability, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Luminous Phantom triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.

combos.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Open the Graves trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Shambling Ghast enters, Blasting Station and Necroduality trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Resolve the Necroduality trigger, creating a token copy of Shambling Ghast.
When the Shambling Ghast token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping it.
Repeat steps 5 through 7 once using the Shambling Ghast token instead.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token and a Food token.
Activate the Insect and Food by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

Cast the self-suspending card by paying its mana cost if its in your hand, or any other spell otherwise if you have not cast a spell this turn.
Cast Part the Waterveil by paying its mana cost.
Taigam triggers, copying Part the Waterveil and then exiling it with four time counters on it and giving it suspend.
Resolve the copy of Part the Waterveil, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of that turn's upkeep, Part the Waterveil and the self-suspending card's suspend abilities trigger, removing a time counter from each of them.
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing three time counters from Part the Waterveil and the self-suspending card, triggering their suspend abilities.
Resolve the self-suspending card's suspend trigger, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost, and eventually exile it with time counters on it.
Resolve the Part the Waterveil's suspend trigger, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 3.
combos.prerequisites: You have a storm count of 1 if the self-suspending card is not in your hand, or a storm count of 0 otherwise.

results: Infinite copies of a specific land
combos.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two untapped Everywhere land tokens due to Spelunking.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two untapped Everywhere land tokens due to Spelunking.
Repeat from step 3.
combos.prerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.

combos.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Timeless Witness.
When Timeless Witness and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Timeless Witness trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Warp from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Warp during your draw step.
Repeat.

Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing The Master.
When The Master dies, if it was a copy of the undying creature, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of the persist creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Otherwise, if The Master was a copy of the persist creature, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of the undying creature with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When The Master enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

Activate Reito Lantern by paying {3}, putting Threefold Thunderhulk on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Threefold Thunderhulk into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Threefold Thunderhulk enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating three 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing Threefold Thunderhulk and two Gnomes, adding six {C}.
Repeat.

results: Near-infinite mana lands you control can produce
combos.description:
Cast Frantic Search by paying {2}{U}.
Chandra and Displacer Kitten triggers.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Chandra.
Resolve the Chandra trigger, creating a copy of Frantic Search.
Resolve the copy of Frantic Search, looting twice and untapping three lands you control that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}{U}.
Activate the three lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}{U}.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Frantic Search.
 Chandra and Displacer Kitten triggers.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Chandra.
Resolve the Chandra trigger, creating a copy of Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the Narset's Reversal copy, creating a copy of the original Narset's Reversal targeting Frantic Search and returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve Narset's Reversal, creating a copy of Frantic Search and returning it to your hand.
Resolve Frantic Search, looting twice and untapping three lands you control that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}{U}.
Activate the three lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}{U}.
Activate Chandra's third loyalty ability by removing four loyalty counters from it, dealing four damage to up to two targets.
Repeat.

results: Infinitely large creature until end of turn
combos.description:
Cast Through the Breach by paying {4}{R}.
Storm-Kiln Artist and Veyran trigger twice.
Resolve the Veyran triggers, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Through the Breach.
Storm-Kiln Artist and Veyran trigger twice.
Resolve the Veyran triggers, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the copy of Through the Breach, putting Rootha from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 5.

results: Cast any number of spells from opponents' libraries
Exile all nonland cards from opponents' libraries
combos.description:
Cast Mana Severance by paying {1}{U}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to create a copy of Mana Severance.
Resolve each opponent's Mana Severance, searching their libraries for all land cards, exiling them and shuffling their library.
Resolve your Mana Severance, exiling no lands cards from your library and shuffling your library.
Cast Selective Memory by paying {3}{U}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to create a copy of Selective Memory.
Resolve each opponent's Selective Memory, exiling the rest of each opponent's library.
Resolve your Selective Memory, exiling no nonland cards from your library and shuffling your library.

Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Tooth and Claw by sacrificing two creatures, creating two 3/1 Carnivore creature tokens.
Repeat step 2.
combos.prerequisites:
Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
You control at least two additional creatures

combos.description:
Cast Murderous Redcap by paying {2}{B/R}{B/R}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
When Murderous Redcap enters the battlefield, it triggers, dealing an amount of damage to itself equal to its power.
Murderous Redcap dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Murderous Redcap's persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Repeat from step 2.

results: Infinite mana creatures you control can produce
combos.description:
Activate Berta by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the Fractal enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Xavier Sal's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing the Fractal, causing you to proliferate and put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Repeat.

Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Skyshroud Ranger.
Repeat.

results: Infinite mana lands you control can produce
Infinite untap of nontoken artifacts you control
Infinite mana nontoken artifacts you control can produce
Infinite untap of lands you control
combos.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Gilded Lotus and Candelabra of Tawnos as they are lands due to Toph.
Repeat.

results: Put all lands from your library onto the battlefield tapped
combos.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Chocobo Racetrack triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

Play Orzhov Basilica.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it, Elfsworn Giant, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elfsworn Giant trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it and Elfsworn Giant trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Putrid Goblin, adding {R}.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Renata.
Repeat.

Activate a permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {1} and tapping it, creating two token copies of Felidar Guardian that are 1/1 Balloons with haste.
When the Felidar Guardian tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, blinking the mana-producing permanent and The Jolly Balloon Man.
Repeat.

results: Put all lands from your library onto the battlefield tapped
combos.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Wight of the Reliquary triggers, untapping Wight of the Reliquary.
Resolve the Wight of the Reliquary ability from step 1, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, The Necrobloom triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.

combos.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Prowling Geistcatcher.
When Saffi dies, Prowling Geistcatcher's first ability triggers, exiling Saffi from your graveyard.
Resolve the Saffi ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Prowling Geistcatcher.
When Prowling Geistcatcher dies, its second ability and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Prowling Geistcatcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Prowling Geistcatcher trigger, returning Saffi from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Smothering Abomination triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Roon by paying {2} and tapping it, exiling Eternal Witness until the beginning of your end step.
At the beginning of your end step, Roon triggers, returning Eternal Witness from exile to the battlefield.
Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, putting Temporal Manipulation into your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat each turn.

Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Amareth triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Amareth trigger, causing you to look at the top card of your library, which will be Sensei's Divining Top, and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

results: Infinitely powerful creature until end of turn
combos.description:
Cast Combat Celebrant by paying {2}{R} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Combat Celebrant enters, its offspring ability triggers, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Nesting Dovehawk triggers, creating a copy of the Combat Celebrant token.
Declare a Combat Celebrant token as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks. It then triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

Cast Werefox Bodyguard by paying its mana cost.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Werefox Bodyguard trigger, exiling White Plume Adventurer until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Werefox Bodyguard.
Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield, causing White Plume Adventurer to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When White Plume Adventurer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the White Plume Adventurer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Werefox Bodyguard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Werefox Bodyguard trigger, exiling White Plume Adventurer until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Werefox Bodyguard.
Repeat from step 5.

Play Simic Growth Chamber. When it enters untapped due to Archelos, Simic Growth Chamber and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Wayward Swordtooth.
Because of the additional Wayward Swordtooth token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn

combos.description:
Declare Squall and Fear of Missing Out as attackers.
Fear of Missing Out's second ability triggers, untapping Squall and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Fear of Missing Out.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Squall, triggering Squall's second ability, returning Fear of Missing Out from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fear of Missing Out enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to rummage.
Repeat each combat phase.

Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and High-Society Hunter trigger.
Resolve the High-Society Hunter trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

results: Infinite mana creatures you control can produce
Infinite untap of creatures you control
combos.description:
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Nissa and Retreat to Coralhelm twice.
Resolve both Nissa triggers, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the first Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, causing you to either tap or untap a creature, or scry 1.
Resolve the second Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Scaled Herbalist.
Activate Mina and Denn by paying {R}{G} and returning the land from the battlefield to your hand, giving target creature trample until end of turn.
Repeat.

Activate Luxurious Locomotive's crew ability by tapping five creatures you control with total power 1 or greater, causing Luxurious Locomotive to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Declare Luxurious Locomotive as an attacker.
Luxurious Locomotive triggers, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Holding priority, activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}. 
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

Declare Najeela and at least two other Warriors as attackers.
Najeela triggers at least three times, creating at least three 1/1 Warrior creature tokens that are tapped and attacking.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing three Warriors, adding {6}.
Activate Najeela by paying {5}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

results: Return all creature cards from all graveyards to the battlefield under your control
Infinite card draw for any number of players
Infinite draw triggers for any number of opponents
Infinite mana lands you control can produce
Infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control
Infinite untap of lands you control
combos.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Palinchron from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Palinchron, adding {B}.
Repeat.

Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of Coretapper with haste.
Activate the token Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
 Activate the token Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

results: Prevent all damage that would be dealt to you
combos.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: You control another land.

combos.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Sanctum Weaver from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Sanctum Weaver by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

results: Infinite mana creatures you control can produce
Infinite untap of creatures you control
combos.description:
Activate Avatar Kyoshi by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Avatar Kyoshi.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Goblin creature tokens equal to the number of Goblins you control.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Krenko, adding {R}.
Choose to return Krenko to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing a Goblin, adding {R}.
Repeat step 4 until you have enough mana to cast Krenko.
Cast Krenko from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{R} plus commander tax.
Repeat.

Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to it.
Triskelion triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vorinclex.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Greenweaver Druid by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Scryb Ranger by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Greenweaver Druid.
Cast Scryb Ranger by paying {1}{G}.
Repeat.

Activate Xu-Ifit by tapping it, returning a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature returned in step 1.
When the creature dies, Xu-Ifit triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard

combos.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.

When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons and Illusionist's Stratagem from your graveyard to your hand.

Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.

Activate Auntie Blyte by paying {1}{R}, tapping them, and removing any number of +1/+1 counters from them, dealing that much damage to any target.

Intruder Alarm and Animation Module trigger.

When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Naga Fleshcrafter and Phantasmal Image each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Naga Fleshcrafter trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Phantasmal Image trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
combos.prerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.

combos.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Expropriate by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Expropriate.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Expropriate spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Expropriate spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Expropriate and returning the original Expropriate to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Expropriate from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take at least two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your last extra turn.

results: Infinite untap of permanents you control
Infinite mana permanents you control can produce
combos.description:
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{U}.
Activate Derevi by paying {1}{G}{W}{U}, putting it onto the battlefield from the command zone.
Put Derevi into your graveyard due to the legend rule, and then choose to return Derevi to the command zone.
Derevi's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers twice due to Virtue of Knowledge.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Bloom Tender.
Holding priority, activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{U}.
Resolve the second Derevi trigger, untapping Bloom Tender.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: You control a copy or clone of Derevi that is legendary and has Derevi's name.

combos.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

results: Put all lands from your hand and library onto the battlefield
combos.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm and Omnath's second ability triggers.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Walking Atlas.
Resolve the Omnath trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on an Elemental you control, and then causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand due to Abundance.
Repeat.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Golgari Thug, adding {C}{C}.
When Golgari Thug dies, it, Pitiless Plunderer and Korvold's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Korvold trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw Golgari Thug from the top of your library.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Golgari Thug by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.
If desired, you may instead use Golgari Thug's dredge ability to return it to your hand to mill your library.

results: Return all creature cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
combos.description:
Cast Ruthless Technomancer either from your hand or graveyard by paying {3}{B}.
When Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Muldrotha and create six Treasure artifact tokens.
When Muldrotha dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Muldrotha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Ruthless Technomancer, causing target player to mill cards equal to Ruthless Technomancer's power.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{B}{B}.
Cast Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard by paying {B}, attaching it to Muldrotha.
Repeat.

Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping the mana-producing creature.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Repeat.

combos.description:
Cast any other Eldrazi except Drowner of Truth by paying its mana cost, triggering Ulalek.
Holding priority, cast Drowner of Truth by paying {4}{C}{G/U}{G/U}.
Drowner of Truth and Ulalek trigger.
Resolve the Ulalek trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy all spells you control and then copy all activated and triggered abilities you control, ensuring to put Drowner of Truth's trigger on top of Ulalek's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Drowner of Truth's trigger, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the copy of Ulalek's trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy all spells you control and then copy all activated and triggered abilities you control, ensuring to put Drowner of Truth's trigger on top of Ulalek's trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.

Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

When the Deep Forest Hermit token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing three Squirrels, adding six {C}.

When Gruff Triplets enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two token copies of itself.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Gruff Triplets token, adding {C}{C}.

Activate Triskelavus' first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Triskelavite creature token.
Rosie triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Triskelavite, adding {C}{C}.

Sorcerer's Broom triggers, causing you to pay {3} to create two creature tokens due to Mondrak.

Sacrifice Magus of the Coffers to Ashnod's Altar adding {C}{C}.
